students.Name: Airi
students.Roles: MS debuff, Aspd debuff, Aspd buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: %Attack speed sub kinda meh. +2 debuffs for Greg
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Airi's kit isn't bad on paper... but it attempts to solve a problem that doesn't exist. If for some reason we ever need to decrease the attack speed of an enemy, she'd definitely see use. At least, there can be some niche use cases to utilise her team wide attack speed buff... but this is a fairly specific scenario that doesn't happen often.

students.Name: Akari
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: All-rounder. Good filler for when your main options are exhausted.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Equiped with two extremely potent stacking steroids, Akari is a flexible student who is capable of dishing out both strong AOE burst and sustained damage. Her HP passive might seem a little useless, but it can prove to be a clutch factor to surviving AOE attacks or for taking some attention off of your main tank. Having a mixed bag of tools means she's not the best in each of these departments, but being good at everything means you can find her useful any time.

students.Name: Aru
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good for most PvE content. Excels in all AOE and ST roles
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Aru's high EX multipliers coupled with self-crit buffs makes her an extremely powerful burst nuke against any enemy. What's more, her EX is also AOE which allows her damage potential to shoot up to ridiculous levels if you can cram more enemies into her range. On the other hand, Aru has basically no output without her EX, so she will always fall into the main DPS role where you will need to plan your team around her EX rotations carefully.

students.Name: Asuna
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Standard AA DPS and 2 cost cycler. Good unit for safe dps
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A good auto attacker who can consistently push out solid DPS while staying out of trouble with her movement skill. If you'd like, you can send her into trouble too to have her eat damage in place of your other units. She requires a decent amount of investment to get going though, so it's very easy to overlook her. The opportunity cost problem with Millenium materials doesn't help her case.

students.Name: Ayane
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good AOE heals with extra buffs to help team survival
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Ayane drops a heal package that heals everything within a certain radius... and that's about it. You might also consider her for her HP% sub, which boosts the survivability of your whole team by a bit - it's nothing game changing for Raids though.

students.Name: Chinatsu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cleanse + strong single target heal can be useful sometimes. Not priority but good enough if lacking options
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Single target healer who cleanses after healing... that's it.

students.Name: Chise
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: RNG Sub. Really high dps if sub has good uptime
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Low effort and solid DPS, Chise is as easy to use as her easy personality. She is capable of both sustained AOE damage with her EX skill, and sustained single target automatic damage. This multi-purpose kit means you can drop her in any blue team and she will perform the way you want her to.

students.Name: Eimi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Self sufficient and effective out-of-the-box. Deal good dps as a tank
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Eimi is a self-heal tank who brings her own red damage to the table. She's honestly quite the simple character and doesn't really do much else. Just like some other tanks, she has an opportunity cost problem in Millenium materials, but frankly she is very capable even if you don't invest in any of her skills. Tank is a tank. Solid all round.

students.Name: Fuuka
students.Roles: Healer, Reposition, DEF buff, CRes buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good heal and repos but ex cost is too expensive. Usually the backup option
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Being a multi-target healer with the additional gimmick of repositioning your entire team, Fuuka enables you to pull your students out of danger. Her skill can be used offensively too by forcing your students to take more favourable positions to set up their skills if they have funny range requirements.

students.Name: Hanae
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Highest ST heal value. Cdmg buff is good statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hanae has the highest single target healing ability in the game. If you had a mission to bring back a single unit from near death to full health, then Hanae does that job and then some. Two drawbacks however: First it takes 20 seconds. Second it's a little bit overkill since we don't have much content which warrants that level of healing. Otherwise, she's highly desireable for the crit damage sub skill which allows you to slot her onto any team you want.

students.Name: Hare
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Sad damage; CC maybe used in team 4's if you run out for HOD and Wakamo
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hare is yet another student who offers an AOE stun. Just like the other AOE stunners, there's not enough content in the game which supports the need for this skill. Even in content where you could use her, the low duration of her CC means Hare by herself is unable to satisfy basic mechanics. If she did more damage she might have been servicable, but she's sadly lacking in that aspect.

students.Name: Haruka
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Pure HP/DEF tank. Stat and investment reliant
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Haruka is the purest tank in Blue Archive. Her entire kit focuses on giving her the highest combination of HP and DEF values in the game, letting her survive without assistance for quite a long time. She is not everyones first choice due to the opportunity cost in Gehenna materials, but if you manage to get her going she won't be dying anytime soon. A tank is a tank.

students.Name: Haruna
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Standard DPS for blue content. Use her anytime.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Having low cost, high base stats, strong multiplier, and projectile capable of hitting multiple enemies, Haruna can and will dump out potent mystic DPS. Her HP passive means she can eat quite a few shots before needing to attend to her too. As long as you're not aiming backwards Haruna is a bread and butter unit to any blue raid.

students.Name: Hasumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Great ST with proper setup. Requires excessive effort compared to other characters though.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Under all the right conditions, Hasumi is able to deal a single hit of insane crit damage. Getting to this point is extremely difficult and expensive though, and requires a lot of money and planning to make it work. If you're willing to put in that effort to make those stars align, Hasumi will have good payoff... but Iori (and others) can do it cheaper.

students.Name: Hibiki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good Nuker and AOE flex unit. Statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hibiki is a powerful do-it-all unit. She has wide AOE sweeps - which is also adaptable to be a concentrated nuke - a crit damage self buff to take that damage to greater heights, and another teamwide crit damage buff to make sure that the thing your shooting is really dead. You can stick her onto almost any team without thought, she'll work out even if you're only using her for her crit buff.

students.Name: Hifumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Some AOE capability though you won't rely on it. Most useful for decoy and CC
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hifumi doesn't contribute much damage vs a single target, but she is useful in many other ways. Peroro-sama is a fantastic skill to help redirect the attention of fatal boss skills off of your team. It can be used to block regular attacks and soak damage for extended periods of time. Against Yellow mobs, an invested Hifumi can help substantially with wave clear. All round a good second choice for some raids.

students.Name: Hina
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Powerful AA option, and also good AOE option. Not suitable for burst/carry roles.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Although cursed with a difficult EX skill, Hina is quite a powerful auto attacker. To get to this point though you will need to dig fairly deep into your pockets. If you manage to push her regular skills to at least lv7 she quite easily becomes one of the best Auto Attackers in the game, even off-colour. Unfortunately this is at the opportunity cost of Gehenna materials which is in high demand already.

students.Name: Hoshino
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Self sufficient all round tank. Solid AA damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hoshino is another shotgun tank who is respectably bulky and also brings her own yellow damage to the table. Her AOE stun might serve useful against CC'able bosses, and her potent emergency heal can bring her through some really tough situations... but other than that, a tank is a tank. Solid all round.

students.Name: Iori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Versatile and powerful striker you can use for many things
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Deleting a boss? Iori. Sweeping up mobs? Iori.
Need a hypercarry? Iori. Need a filler dps? Iori.
Missing units for a blue team? Iori. Red ones too? (Maybe) Also Iori.
Blue Archive? Iori.

students.Name: Izumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: The good old RNG character, if you managed to proc her normal everytime it's up then she is a god
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Although her kit looks like a mess, Izumi is quite capable as an auto attacker who you can throw into a fight and forget about. Her normal skill does a respectable amount of damage, and with the backing of her sub skill, Izumi will surely rack up good numbers over a period of time. You wouldn't use it under normal circumstances, but her EX skill is quite useful as an emergency button to keep her topped up without the need to spend a healer skill. A solid option if you don't want to micro manage your entire team at once.

students.Name: Junko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Balanced character flexible in main and sub DPS roles
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A well balanced character with good stats, good multipliers, good range, good DPS, and even good burst. There's nothing wrong with Junko at all. Players might be tempted to try to minmax her sub skill by letting her stay on low health, but even without doing that her damage is fantastic. Junkos only problem is that she's not Iori. Easily one of the better Yellow units otherwise.

students.Name: Juri
students.Roles: DOT, Aspd debuff, HP buff, (Enemy) Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Kaiten repos
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Juri is capable of pulling movable enemies into a smaller area. This allows you to set up your AOE damage dealers for better sucess. Unfortunately, the use case for this is limited to exactly one scenario for half a raid. The Kaiten Rangers must be quite desperate to be attracted to Pan-chan.

students.Name: Karin
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can out-dps unbuffed strikers. Great nuke and gold standard for stat sticks
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Having one of the highest raw ATK stats out of any specialist as well as a teamwide ATK buff, Karin brings a decent value to any team even if she didn't do any damage. But Karin does do damage, and it's often enough to outperform many unbuffed Yellow strikers. Her buffs don't outperform dedicated ATK buffers, but there may be scenarios where you don't have room for a dedicated ATK buffer - Karin will thus fill in the slot better. She is also the gold standard for ATK statsticks, and every other special's stats are compared to her.

students.Name: Kayoko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes:
Best free CC.
But the real cost is your hair.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kayoko's entire kit revolves around Fear, and she's certainly very good at that. Noone else matches Kayoko's duration, range, and frequency of CC. If you are in need of a student who does literally nothing but CC a thing for a very long time, then Kayoko is simply the best at it... you won't use her for any other reason.

students.Name: Kotama
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Default ATK buffer, 3* preferred
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: If you don't know what you're doing, Kotama is by default included into any and every raid setup. She provides a team wide attack buff, twice. That's great, no questions needed. If you really had to ask though, she does fall off if you're unable to use her EX, or unable to buff multiple members of your team at once - In which case you either know what you're doing or you're screwing up immensely.

students.Name: Kotori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Repositioning with a good shield is nice for surviving AOE from bosses. Shield duration is really bad but it'll do its job
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A team wide shield which forces your team to reposition has its uses. Kotori can take your team out of danger, or pad your team with temporary HP to survive strong attacks that would otherwise oneshot you. Obviously she doesn't do any damage, but survivability is important too and Kotori can help fill out your teams and keep them healthier for longer. In most you'd prefer to use a proper healer like Koharu, but Kotori particularly shines in content where healing is reduced.

students.Name: Maki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Boss slayer. Usable in any ST content, including vs Chesed's open core. Paintball is a very effective def down
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: If Blue Archive was a not-happy game, Maki would shoot blood instead of paint to represent her position as one of the strongest yellow DPS. The high multiplier EX skill coupled with her sub skill gives her extremely potent burst damage, and the self ATK and attack speed buffs means she is also able to constantly push out non-stop DPS. The DEF shred is the cherry on top of this unstoppable cake. The default pick for any single target yellow content, while being useful in blue ones too.

students.Name: Mutsuki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Best long-term DPS but need to reposition her properly for triple mines. Lower rating otherwise
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Capable of dealing the highest cost free DPS out of any explosive student, Mutsuki is an extremely powerful unit you don't know how to use. In order to hit this godly damage ceiling, you will need to specifically build your team so that she is capable of landing all of her mines on the enemy. This is obviously inconvenient for players who don't have the capacity to do that. Great unit for tryhards who are chasing the highest score possible, but a bit of a struggle bus for people who want it easy.

students.Name: Neru
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good ST for cheap cost, need good investment to use
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Neru is an extremely powerful single target damage dealer during her buff cycle, especially for how cheap her EX skill costs. Unfortunately, she falls off dramatically outside of her enraged buff, so misuse of Neru will also not be very fruitful. Her EX hits the enemy 60 times, which has interactions with certain boss mechanics or other characters (namely Weakness Detection).

students.Name: Nonomi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Godsend Free AOE Unit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Capable of dealing silly good crit damage values across a wide area, Nonomi is often a default pick when it comes to Yellow mobbing content. The cost of her EX skill is a bit on the expensive side, but it's more than worth its value. She's infamously known as Nonomiss, so you might bash your head in a bit sometimes using her.

students.Name: Saya
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: %Crit Chance Sub isn't good, but her EX is really strong for mobbing
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Saya's acid pool is extremely effective and cost efficient vs tight groups of enemies. Crit chance sub skills are not as powerful as crit damage sub skills, so she's often overshadowed by other specialists in most content. However she will certainly see use if you are can continously keep multiple enemies within her AOE.

students.Name: Serika
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Insane ST with triple steroid for when you need 2 cost rotate
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: The least flashiest unit in the game, but still somehow tops all of your damage graphs without you noticing. Serika is a cheap, easy, powerful, and flexible unit you can fit into any team comp. She doesn't require any baby sitting and will put in a lot of work via constant automatic attacks without you realising - all the while her cheap EX skill means you can cycle faster and use the other big flashy skills more often. A solid unit to any Red content.

students.Name: Serina
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Default Special Healer you will use anytime anywhere
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Frequent cheap fast effective healing. Serina.

students.Name: Shimiko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Juggles balls and cups really well
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shimiko provides cover, a shield, and defence buffs to the entire team. It sounds OK, but there is currently no need for such a variety of defensive tools in one student. More often than not you would prefer to use dedicated supports. You will probably use Shimiko if you've exhausted dedicated options and you still have a need to block or divert incoming damage.

students.Name: Shiroko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Low cost Ex with good multiplier and competent idle damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shiroko is an all round good unit, but doesn't excel at anything in particular. She has good auto attack damage, but nothing dramatically exciting. Her EX skill isn't the most impressive on the damage deparment, but it's good enough for its low cost and it helps you cycle through to your other more impressive skills. Not your first choice when you want the biggest DPS possible, but certainly still a good one.

students.Name: Shun
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: ONLY USED FOR SPEED RUNS
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shun is a PvP unit through and through, but she does have some niche use in raids. Her cost battery at the start of the fight means she appears in speed run strategies where the goal is to finish the fight in less than a minute. She isn't used very much outside this niche as her damage potential is farily low unless you can proc her sub skill (e.g. in Kaiten).

students.Name: Sumire
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Has pretty solid damage with decent AOE cover. Very durable too.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A mixed bag of AOE burst damage and a little bit of tankiness. Fantastic in the niche of eliminating many mobs while soaking damage, but this is unfortunately not a very common problem.

students.Name: Suzumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Decent CC bot with bond gear, but still incapable of any damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: If you need an AOE stun, Suzumi at least is capable of providing that - but her AA damage isn't very impressive so you'll struggle to find a use for her otherwise. That's all she really has going for her.

students.Name: Tsubaki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: "The" Blue Archive tank. Default option you can always rely on
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Good defence, high HP, high evasion - Tsubaki is the default tank you turn to when you're in need of someone who can take a long and hard beating. Unmatched in pure survivability, she also comes with a taunt to help with CC'able bosses. You're probably already using her anyway.

students.Name: Tsurugi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Really needs full investment to get her train going. Maxed skills and bond gear completely change her play.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: One of few units in the game with significant AOE tied to her basic attacks. She's fantastic at her niche, which is clearing out swathes of mobs while drain-tanking any incoming damage... but this scenario isn't very common.

students.Name: Utaha
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Decoy Turret to bait Binah, tanking Kuro's cup, attract Peroro laser
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Currently, Utaha's turrents are more of a tanking device than a damage device. You would use them to draw temporarily draw aggro away from your team, or to use them to block an incoming enemy skill. They're cheap to summon, but also not very bulky. A decent pick if you're running out of survivability tools.

students.Name: Yoshimi
students.Roles: Mobber, CC, CC Res debuff, CC POW buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Has CC, has AOE damage, excels at neither but usable in either.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: An AOE stun against yellow enemies which does decent damage isn't particularly bad on paper - Blue Archive just doesn't have any content to support that scenario well enough. Yoshimi is usable if you're in need of more AOE Yellow damage or AOE CC, but you often have better dedicated options in either department.

students.Name: Yuuka
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Despite having ginourmous thighs and a thicc HP pool, enemies still can't hit her
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: When it comes to raids, any tank is a good tank. Yuuka is a good starter who is unfortunately quickly forgotten when players begin to diversify their roster to fulfill various needs - but her ability to tank in a raid isn't any worse than the others. She has the highest HP pool in the game, meaning she has more value against bosses who can shred your teams DEF. Her I.F.F is quite the powerful ability too, letting her contribute to your teams damage against a red boss. Overall a solid EVA tank you can use anywhere anytime.

students.Name: フィーナ
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good Binah DPS
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Although she is overshadowed by Maki in every facet, Fpfina is still a fantastic secondary or complementary choice for both burst damage and sustained AA damage against a single unmoving enemy. Falls off dramatically when any moving about is required.

students.Name: Mashiro
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Gacha gameplay in my gacha game
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: In terms of pure damage against a single target, Mashiro is acceptably usable. The randomness of her EX skill is kind of annoying but damage is damage and she gets the job done. She doesn't offer anything else of value though, so you are unlikely to field her unless you are missing damage dealers for your C team.

students.Name: Akane
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good and cheap Ex, default option for def down
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Akane is equipped with a potent DEF down on a low cost EX skill, so you will often be bringing her to any high DEF boss. Even against low DEF bosses that won't see much benefit from her debuff, she is at least still servicable as a skill cycler if you are running out of options. Akane is thus a useful option in any raid.

students.Name: Izuna
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: High% crit bombs every few seconds makes her top tier carry
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Izuna's crit damage infused bombs has the highest cost-free damage ceiling among all blue DPS in the game. She is an absurdly strong auto attacker who comes with the ability to either reposition herself away to safety or right into the face of danger to help mitigate damage to other students. You can flex her into both an idle AA role or focus all your buffs on her for a single target hyper-carry role. She's even strong enough to compete with red units in red raids. Nin Nin

students.Name: Shizuko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cover is good for ShiroKuro
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shizuko drops a piece of cover that can absorb incoming damage. It's a servicable tool for survivability, but often not your first choice. Sometimes her ATK debuff can come in handy to clutch out some scenarios where you might have overwise died - however if you're experiencing this issue in lower difficulties it'll be easier to overcome it with sheer firepower instead.

students.Name: Aris
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Excellent for making roast chicken skewers with her high firepower and straight-line AOE.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Against a single enemy, Arisu's slow auto attacks and excessive EX cost will often drain the damage output of your team as you try to slowly build that SP bar... but the pay off is immense against against multiple targets. For each enemy Arisu can hit, her damage potential multiplies. Consequently, she does even better if you can invest the proper resources into her. She requires a tiny bit of technical ability though, as you need to aim her skill shot and monitor her energy charge. If you can do this she will consistently perform well.

students.Name: Midori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Poorman Iori
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A flexible unit who is capable of spreading damage out across many enemies, or focus firing a single one for respectable burst damage. You can choose to fit her into any Yellow team you like and she will perform great in either role you choose. Sounds a bit like Iori, doesn't it? Unfortunately, Midori is actually balanced.

students.Name: Momoi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cheap AOE skill, good for cycle
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Momoi excels at being a fast and cheap AOE damage dealer without compromising too much on range. Her damage isn't exactly impressive, but it's just enough to kill the common mob standing in your way; which is all that matters. Performs slightly better with her twin Midori, but is enough of a great unit on her own.

students.Name: Cherino
students.Roles: Mobber, Cost support, Focus Fire, Crit Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: big aoe, ex5 for chesed, upgrade sub and normal if you want to use her outside for her support ability
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Cherino offers a combination of two powerful support abilities: The ability to passively increase your cost regeneration for an entire fight, and the ability to shred the Crit Damage Resistance of an enemy. These attributes make her a highly capable unit which you can bring to any raid as they greatly increase the potential of your entire team. The cherry on top is her ability to clear yellow mobs in a large radius around her, making her a core unit in any yellow mobbing content.

students.Name: Nodoka
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Best acc buffer... for what?
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Nodoka is a dedicated anti-evasion support who is frankly quite good at the job. Sadly it's a job that doesn't have any demand. If we have a boss with obnoxious levels of evasion in the future she will definitely get some use, but for now there isn't really much reason to field her.

students.Name: Yuzu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Have fun malding with crit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Yuzu's kit and stats alone aren't bad, but it's not very impressive either. At max investment levels, she manages to to well for herself due to her uniquely high crit stats. She is amongst the strongest units in the game if you can get her to crit, but also amongst the weakest units in the game if she can't crit.

students.Name: Azusa
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Def down + insane single target multiplier.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Having both the highest EX skill damage and one of few with a DEF down amongst Explosive students, Azusa is a core unit in any Red raid. Her single target focus means she isn't always useful against a bunch of mobs, but that doesn't stop her from being a fantastic "delete" button you can bring to a boss fight.

students.Name: Hanako
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: The only unit that can buff another units healing
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Pure AOE healer that does nothing but heal. Hanako comes with the bonus of buffing your entire teams heal stat too, if for some reason you don't have enough healing. This can help come in clutch for meeting certain heal thresholds where you need it

students.Name: Koharu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Default striker healer. Covers all your needs for Extreme
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Koharu is a healer from the striker position, relieving the need of a healer from the specialist slots and allowing you to run an extra damage dealer or buffer from that slot instead. Her cheap, potent, and consistent healing also enables players to go tankless, enabling yet another DPS slot. Although you might eventually outgrow the need for healing, she is among the most valuable unit for flexibility in teambuilding, especially when attempting to clear the next highest difficulty for the first time.

students.Name: Azusa (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Best ST blue without the need to crit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Even if she did no damage, being one of few units in the game with a DEF down on a sub skill means you will somehow somewhere be able to find S.Azusa useful against any boss with a lot of DEF, not just blue ones. Luckily, S.Azusa is also the strongest Mystic single target critless damage dealer - this ability to not need to rely on crit while still giving top output will easily give her a spot in any blue content.

students.Name: Mashiro (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: DPS, CDmg buff, ACC buff, EVA debuff,
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Need investment and different timing for her to work in raid due to her normal
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Mashiro is mostly known to be a PvP unit, but it is possible to use her in niche raid setups as well. Since she has a crit damage buff on her Normal skill, you could potentially work her into a hyper carry comp to take your core DPS unit's damage even further - this is very tricky to set up though since her skill uptime isn't the best. Otherwise, her Blue damage is acceptable if you're lacking in that department.

students.Name: Tsurugi (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Really good for a welfare unit, upgrade passive and sub for pure AA
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Tsurugi is the go to unit if you need someone to eat bullets without sacrificing your blue DPS. A fantastic risk-free student that requires no baby sitting.

students.Name: Hifumi (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 10 Cost EX render her very hard to use but the damage is insane, very good for extreme
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: If you're willing to wait 24 seconds to charge 10 cost, S.Hifumi's Crusader Tank is a very powerful addition to the team. The tank constantly pumps out strong blasts of AOE damage allowing her to easily take care of waves of Yellow mobs by herself. The tank is strong enough that the rest of your team can take a break and recover the 10 cost you spent summoning her. Getting 10 cost in the first place is an entire issue on its own though.

students.Name: Hina (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solid out-of-the-box option for multi-target roles. Falls behind other units with investment
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Having a low cost, large AOE ex skill with decent multipliers, S.Hina has very high damage potential if you are able to maximise the amount of targets in her range. She also periodically applies a stun to her attack target, allowing CC'able bosses to be more manageable. Unfortunately, her damage against a single target is not very good, so her use cases are limited to AOE scenarios.

students.Name: Iori (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: High ATK base with double debuff to enable debuff reliant carries. Among the best 0 cost red DPS
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: With two different instances of DoT debuff built into her kit, S.Iori will quickly rack up the damage counter without you even noticing. It's unfortunate that her EX skill is quite terrible, having bad mutlipliers and range for its cost, but she is nonetheless a very strong auto attacker to have on a red team

students.Name: Izumi (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Really good for kaiten phase 1
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Izumi has an all round solid kit that gives her access to good auto attacks and an EX skill with great utility and damage. You can choose to leave her alone to do her thing, or choose to use her multi-hitting EX skill to chain stun mobs or CC'able bosses. Either choice is a good one, and she will satisfactorily fulfill either need.

students.Name: Shiroko (Cycling)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Her Ex can be a life saver at some moment, and can act as an AA bot
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: R.Shiroko fulfills a niche of decreasing the damage dealt against your team. She's without a doubt good at doing this, considering she halves the ATK value of all enemies hit, but she doesn't have much else going for her. She has solid auto attack DPS at least if you're struggling to fill in slots on a blue team.

students.Name: Kirino
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kirino is a PvP unit that currently does not translate very well to raid. If for whatever reason we need to reduce a bosses accuracy and recovery rate in the future, she might be useful. Certainly not good right now though.

students.Name: Shun (Small)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Alternative carry option. Large nuke for large problems, but won't solve your small ones.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Equipped with a high multiplier EX which has the additional ability to ignore DEF, L.Shun is a good unit for laying down large bursts of damage. However, she switches between periods of ATK down and ATK up making her fairly difficult to use if you're not paying attention to her buff cycle. She's not very user friendly and can honestly lower your damage output if you treat her poorly - but she is great if you're willing to put in the effort.

students.Name: Saya (Casual)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Yellow AOE so far only used in Chesed. Cdmg sub is good statstick though
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: C.Saya drops a pool of acid that hurts everything standing in it throughout its duration. Quite underwhelming against a single enemy, but extremely effective and cost efficient against waves of enemies. You will definitely get a lot of mileage out of her in any content that involves Yellow mobs. Even without this ability, she is useful to bring along to any team if only for her crit damage sub skill.

students.Name: Karin (Bunny)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Need high investment including UE
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Karin excels at a very specific niche of demolishing groups of high DEF enemies. This is enabled by her innate DEF pen, high base stats, high multiplier, and wide AOE range. Unfortunately, due to the excessive cost of her EX, she's fairly unusable outside of this niche. Requires a bit of investment to get going, but will definitely destroy anything in her way if you set her up for success.

students.Name: Neru (Bunny)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Useful where you need taunt, but that's not often
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Bunny Neru is an evasion tank with a relatively low HP pool, but she has a shield and a skill-cancelling taunt to help balance her tanking ability. She excels the most when she is able to land her taunt on multiple targets, and she also has impressive damage for a tank. If you're willing to baby sit her to get her out of danger when you're unlucky with evasion rolls, B.Neru is a great unit... for JFD not raids.

students.Name: Asuna (Bunny)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Her Ex is 5 cost make her hard to rotate with everyone but still usable
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Asuna has a DEF down debuff that can be applied to multiple enemies via her EX skill. It lasts for quite a long time (40s) and the multiplier is good as well. Unfortuntely, her use cases are quite limited as it's not every day you run into multiple tightly packed high DEF enemies. If you find a way to fit her into your team she's a nice addition.

students.Name: Mari
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cleanse + Shield is very versatile, especially for 2 cost
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Mari offers a cheap 2 cost shield which cleanses the debuffs of her target. Valuable enough on its own since there is a need for cleanse and shields in some raids. Mari also offers a tiny bit of her own damage and a teamwide HP% buff to help pad out the survivability of the team. With Bond Gear, the additional ability to shred DEF improves her versatility and helps a lot in creating additional teams.

students.Name: Natsu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Versatile tank with her attack buff to all allies
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A multi talented tank who can self heal, self cleanse, and buff the attack of all allies. Natsu's ability to take care of herself and simultaenously provide support to the rest of her team makes her a valuable unit for any piece of content that requires a tank. And hey, most bosses need a tank!

students.Name: Miku
students.Roles: Healer, ATK buff, Crit buff, Recovery buff
students.Skill priority: #N/A (Did not find value 'Miku' in VLOOKUP evaluation.)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: #N/A (Did not find value 'Miku' in VLOOKUP evaluation.)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: #N/A (Did not find value 'Miku' in VLOOKUP evaluation.)

students.Name: Ako
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Hypercarry enabler, turns a regular carry into a super unit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A dedicated crit buffer who takes a single striker on the team to the next level. This buff is so strong Ako enables hyper carry compositions which centres itself around that single DPS dealer. She comes with a potent automatic heal as well which reduces the need for other survability tools. An all-round extremely powerful support - though she won't help you if you're not already strong enough to make the most of the buffs.

students.Name: Cherino (Hot Spring)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Nice in campaign but is not raid unit yet. Statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) O.Cherino summons a tank to the battlefield, which is capable of constantly firing powerful AOE attacks throughout it's lifetime. She is definitely very capable at this... but we don't have a red mobbing raid yet. Will probably be useful if one was ever released. At the very least she's useful for critdmg sub in any team.
(We got a red AOE raid but it's not really mobbing, so she's still unused)

students.Name: Chinatsu (Hot Spring)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Great Attack Speed steroid for any AA-based DPS
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: As a unique unit who applies two stackable attack speed buffs to another student, O.Chinatsu sees usage amongst team compositions built around a single hypercarry who excels with attack speed (e.g. Maki, Izuna). Although this use case is quite limited, noone does this job better than her. Her score is entirely dependent on the units she buffs.

students.Name: Tomoe
students.Roles: MS buff, Crit buff, CDmg buff, (Friendly) Range debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Maybe for low diff speedrun when you need to run very fast.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Tomoe is a capable crit buffer who can raise the damage ceiling of your team. Her debuffs to attack range means she can enable interesting combinations  to help maximise the damage of teams which rely on positioning, such as Mutsuki comps. Not much else to say about Tomoe, besides her ability to make you run fast is funny to look at.

students.Name: Nodoka (Hot Spring)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Is good healer and can be used as statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: O.Nodoka has potent single target heal over time, but she has the additional gimmick of being able to switch between targets. With good investment she can keep your entire team topped up on health for extended durations of time. The attack bonus sub skill makes her a great addition for when you want to balance survivability and DPS.

students.Name: Aru (New Year)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 11 targets ricochet, good for chesed.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY. Aru has an interesting kit that lets her chain a multi target ex skill continously for low cost as long as she manages to successfully kill mobs each cast. May be a bit costly to get started but once shes running she doesn't stop, allowing NY. Aru to chain kill her way through multiple waves of Yellow mobs. Not very useful if you can't get the chain going.

students.Name: Mutsuki (New Year)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cheap, Fast, Powerful AOE. Extremely versatile for any content even outside of Blue
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Just like her original version, NY.Mutsuki has very high damage ceiling - especially when shes facing multiple enemies. And also just like her original, you probably don't know how to use her. NY.Mutsuki has a minimum range requirement with her EX skill, meaning that you have to be very precise with her positioning and her placement within the team. If you put her in the right place, she can absolutely destroy blue enemies. If you can't, then she kinda sandbags your overall damage output.

students.Name: Serika (New Year)
students.Roles: Mobber, ATK buff, CDRes buff, Crit Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: AOE mobber but barely does enough damage to AOE mob.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Solid AOE damage specialist who gets first pick for her large range, low cost EX with just enough damage to do the job of cleaning up mobs. Unfortuntely, this AOE damage role is in very high supply and Nyerika doesn't really offer anything to make her stand out. Also unfortunately competes with supports for the Special slot, so it's hard to find room to ever field her.

students.Name: Fubuki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Free and easy CC with solid AA damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Fubuki is a strong unit against CC'able bosses. The biggest reason why you'd perfer her over other CC units is because her stun is cost free and applied quickly - it's even faster with Attack Speed buffs. Her double ATK steroid also makes her a very competent AA unit. To top it all off, she's a farmable event welfare unit who doesn't share skill materials with anyone important, so you can make her as strong you need.

students.Name: Wakamo
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: High ATK Scaling, work wonderful in any blue team. Can solo stack EX if you manage buffs correctly and time Normal Skill properly.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Wakamo places a time bomb which accumulates the damage dealt against a target - this makes her capable of delivering extremely strong bursts of damage. However, you'll likely use other dps with her to help with the build up because her solo damage is very poor if used incorrectly. In this sense, Wakamo may fulfill more of a support role than a dps one when team building. She is quite capable out of the box, but her potential shoots through the roof if you can push investments to the max.

students.Name: Chihiro
students.Roles: CC, ATK debuff, CC POW buff
students.Skill priority: Basic>Sub>Enhanced (changed due to how insane work)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Premier CC option for Hod and S.Wakamo. ATK debuff has clutch applications
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Chihiro is a stun bot who is tailor made to deal with a single raid boss (HOD). She has the longest stun application in the game as a Special making her very valuable when you need CC against a single yellow entity. That's pretty much all she does though. At the least, you might find use for her ATK down debuff against difficult enemies. Outside of these two niches you won't be using her much.

students.Name: Sena
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strong ATK buff with bad healing. Can act as decoy in some scenarios.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Despite the nurse theme, Sena is not a healer but rather an ATK buffer. She boasts a fairly potent single target ATK buff with great uptime. She also buffs every other unit on the team abliet at a weaker level to the likes of Kotama. Sena's staggering downside lies in her AI for the truck - it doesn't attempt to prioritise keeping your strikers in its aura making it quite difficult to meet her maximum potential. Although you can use her as a decoy tank too, her problems can make her more difficult than she is worth... at least she still has value as an ATK stick in any team.

students.Name: Mimori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good all-round option if you need tank and reposition. Atk speed buff is nice
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Mimori has many tools in her kit - and she's actually good at using most of them. The ability to reposition the entire team for only 3 cost is quite invaluable as a survival tool to evade fatal boss attacks. She also provides an attack speed buff right after, allowing the team to turn around and kill the target faster after having their asses saved. Her auto healing is quite decent, and she also has a respectable amount of HP, Evasion, DEF which lets her be the main tank. All around great support.

students.Name: Hinata
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good AOE and ST flex. Really want B15
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Hinata pulls a mortar out of her woman's 4th dimension pocket and provides large sweeping AOE blue damage to the field. 
...That's it... but at least she's darn good at it. Due to the way her mortars overlap, Hinata is also very competent for ST hypercarry roles against a fat boss. This kind of flexibility makes her highly advantageous for filling out roles in a roster. You REALLY need her bond gear though.

students.Name: Ui
students.Roles: Cost Support, ATK buff, Crit Buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 50% cost reduction for one ally is really really really good
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Ui halves the EX cost of a friendly unit for two skill uses. This is an extremely powerful addition as support in hyper-carry compositions. Her AA damage is kinda mediocre but that isn't very relevant in a hyper-carry comp anyway - in this sense, she's relatively cheap to get going as you can leave her at 3*s and just max her EX. 
Even outside of hyper-carry comps you can still use her in any and all content. Everybody can appreciate their EX cost being halved no matter what you're doing.

students.Name: Marina
students.Roles: Tank, Invincible, Recovery debuff, (Self) Reposition, (Enemy) Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Has silly cheese potential with immortal. Otherwise just solid tank
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Tank is a tank. Marina has the advantage of being an evasion tank who can luck her way out of surviving things other tanks normally can't. The 20 second immortality is quite good in a pinch and the extremely wide EX skill is nice for mopping up mobs too. All round decent.

students.Name: Miyako
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Designed for HOD
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: An evasion/hp tank who provides point-and-click stun and a decent amount yellow damage. Unless you're fighting something that really really needs to be stunned, you would probably pick the myriad of other tanks first before using Miyako. Otherwise, tank is tank.

students.Name: Saki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solid ATK statstick. Good CC otherwise
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Saki drops an AOE stun on the field, dealing ok damage with decent CC duration. Normally this would be extremely underwhelming, but she has the benefit of being an extremely powerful ATK stat-stick competitive with Karin. This gives her some a reason to bring her along to any team.

students.Name: Miyu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: VERY strong unit but only for when you know what you're doing (you don't)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
She was kind enough to put herself in the bin. 
(Just kidding. Miyu is a powerful support DPS for teams of high atkspeed multi hitting AA units where regular EX usage is not entirely favourable, but this scenario is a little specific and is not exactly a common problem. If you DO come across this problem though... she's really strong, almost best in class.)

students.Name: Iroha
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 3 ricochetes per summon means gives her the highest % output for cost vs multi targets
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Once you've coughed up the 6 cost, Iroha's Tiger Tank will periodically shoot a powerful round which ricochets amongst multiple enemies. She will need at least 2 enemies on the field to justify deploying her - however with 4 enemies Iroha becomes an absolute DPS monster. This is all on-top of the fact that she is an extremely potent teamwide ATK buffer, making her a valuable asset for any raid. Just be mindful there is an upper limit to her ricochet, so there is no use bringing her against massive swarms.

students.Name: Kaede
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good shielder but doesn't do anything else
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: At higher levels of investment Kaede can deploy an extremely potent AOE shield for your whole team. AOE shields are especially useful in situations where healing is less effective due to healing reduction or to tank attacks that would otherwise oneshot your units. However there is some serious opportunity cost to push Kaede's shield to the point where it is stronger than any other shielder in the game - and unlike those other units Kaede doesn't give any other additional benefit with the shield.

students.Name: Michiru
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good burst and DPS. Not a hypercarry
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Michiru has a high damage ceiling due to her stacks upon stacks of self crit damage buffs. Incredibly potent against single blue enemies, and can serve as a great additional DPS unit to pad your downtimes. She has good AA damage too, all in all making her a welcome addition to multi-dps teams. Michiru doesn't benefit greatly from hyperbuffs because a large portion of her damage comes from burn.

students.Name: Tsukuyo
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: DEF Down on Normal against Medium enemy make her a good option to pick for Kaiten p1
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Tsukuyo is an evasion tank who particularly excels in surviving against swarms of enemies (or 1 enemy doing many many atacks). Although conditional against medium enemies, her DEF down gives her a handful of use cases outside of a pure tank role. 
Besides that though, tank is tank.

students.Name: Hiyori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 51.6% DEF Down is nice but is mostly just a statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Providing a DEF shred from the Specialist slots makes Hiyori usable in any high-def raid if for whatever reason you can't field Akane. Her teamwide ATK buff makes this benefit extra appealing.

She's even stronger if you deploy her with the rest of the Arius squad, but certainly usable even without.

students.Name: Misaki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Consistent damage throughout the fight, relies on the number of debuff on enemy
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Boasting ludicrously high base ATK, Misaki piles on the DOT and tends to top the damage charts in red raids in a full-length fight. Repeat: Full-length fight. She has a bit of a start-up time to her kit and requires a couple of conditions fulfilled to really activate her damage. This means that even though she has a insanely high damage ceiling, you wouldn't really use her in a short lived engagement. She also has the unfortunate problem of being unsuitable as a hyper-carry pick, so she can be hard to fit into teams.

students.Name: Atsuko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Very strong healing at UE40, can cancel timebomb by keeping everyone at 100% hp, basically your ideal tank but sadly doesn't bring any buff/debuff
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: An evasion tank equipped with team wide heals, Atsuko is a very helpful unit for fights where your team suffers from taking consistent AOE damage. Even if she doesn't provide any other synergies of value, she's unrivalled in this particular role of keeping your whole team alive from the tank slot. This makes her very slot efficient and thus she is a valuable tool in team building. Even without this (big) benefit, tank is tank.

students.Name: Ayane (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: A viable option for Binah since her damage is very consistent. Strong statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
S.Ayane does damage.
A loooooot of damage.
That's it.
If it really came down to it, you would prefer buffers in most situations as your strikers usually would benefit more from a buff than what S.Ayane can contribute with her DEF ignore. But if you really really really need damage in your Special slot... S.Ayane has you covered

students.Name: Nonomi (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: High atk speed with def shred and crazy on-hit multipliers make her solid in any ST red raid
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Nonomi's minigun shoots water bullets but it's secretly a censorship attempt by Nexon because she actually shoots the blood of her enemies. The amount of pure dps she can put down in both burst and AA-DPS roles is absurdly overwhelming. She has access to DEF ignore and also offers teamwide Attack Speed buffs to improve team performance. All of these factors make her an extremely flexible DPS pick for Red content.

students.Name: Wakamo (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Premium CC bot
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Swimsuit Wakamo has a self ATK buff which stacks itself over the course of 3 minutes. Once these stacks are built, her ATK power is effectively doubled. Despite this buff her damage isn't the most impressive compared to other single target yellow dealers - this is the trade off for having the additional benefit of providing a very long stun.

students.Name: Hoshino (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Tank, ATK buff, Red-effectiveness buff, Cost support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Absolutely cracked unit. Universal support for any situation
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Hoshino comes with the ability to convert the weakness damage multiplier from x2.0 to x2.99 for Red allies. This on its own is already busted enough to make her a must have for all Red content - but that's not all she does. She is also a formidable tank, has good AA damage, can self-heal, and boosts the ATK of units around her. Her extremely powerful EX costs next to nothing to use - requiring only 1.6cost after her Sub skill refund. All these aspects make her a powerhouse everywhere.

students.Name: Shizuko (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Shielder, ATK buff, CDmg buff, Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can repos, have atk sub, have crit damage buff, solid unit for comfy in any raid
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Shizuko is a super utility unit with way too many tools in her belt. Her offensive buffs are cost free and provide your team both the highly desired Crit Damage and ATK buffs. Meanwhile, her EX is capable of shielding and repositioning units for only 3 cost. Definitely a capable unit you can use anytime anywhere for anything.

students.Name: Chise (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Just good for CC so far
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
S.Chise throws an AOE centered around an enemy, bouncing two additional times. Against a single enemy this ability is pretty bad, but against a large stunnable swarm of enemies, her damage potential goes to the moon...
Unfortunately there is no raid content with blue stunnable swarms of enemies, so she won't see use for now. In the meantime, she is servicable as an on-demand high value CC applier.

students.Name: Izuna (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Focus Fire, AA, DPS, Crit Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: who thought giving a unit perma crit damage shred was a good idea
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Izuna has a 100% uptime Crit Damage Resistance Shred - this is strong and makes her a strong consideration for any Crit focused team. Her focus focus fire helps your team attack the correct target in raids where mobs or multiple enemies can get in the way of your team's DPS. Even without this benefit, her 2cost EX is worth using for quick cycling. On top of it all her powerful self-buffs easily make S.Izuna one of the better DPS in any blue raid. All this flexibility and power makes her a highly desirable unit for many raids.

students.Name: Saori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solid ST DPS that is servicable on her own. Top tier with all of Arius (but are the rest of Arius good?)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: By herself, Saori is just like any other red DPS unit. Middle of the pack, nothing stand-out, cool to have. But if you can activate her subskill and include other members of Arius in the team Saori becomes quite a powerhouse. With 100% Crit Rate and good mix of self buffs she can quickly dismantle any boss you throw her at. However this does mean teambuilding around Saori is an arduous and inflexible task - not to mention expensive. Besides, not all of Arius are as flexible as Saori herself, so you may not even have room to bring them.

students.Name: Kazusa
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: She has a lot of self atk buff. Solid DPS in both Yellow and Blue
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Boasting five stacking ATK steroids, Kazusa clearly fills 3 unique roles: DPS, DPS, and DPS. She's extremely good at it, and exists purely as a killing machine who single handedly cuts through a single Yellow target. That's all you need to know about her - it's damage all the way down.

students.Name: Moe
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Chesed wave clearer
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Moe deals solid yellow AOE damage. Even though there is an over-saturation of Yellow AOE units, Moe has the extra benefit of doing it from the Specialist slot while passively providing a teamwide ATK buff. This makes teambuilding with her simpler and allows some flexibility in your roster.

students.Name: Kokona
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Most cost efficient single target healer. Cost support is amazing
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Kokona is primarily a healer who happens to provide some cost support as a bonus. There are better dedicated options for either role, but being able to provide both at a proficient level makes her a very flexible and slot-efficient pick. You can't really go wrong with Kokona, but you want to avoid her in content where healing is reduced or on teams that do not have multi-hits. 
If you can use her on a team with an absurd amount of multi-hits, her cost saving is actually equally as effective as other cost savers.

students.Name: Hibiki (Cheer Squad)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: i wonder where we can utilize 2 minutes DoT
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: C.Hibiki has the highest base-ATK and also the biggest AOE ability in the game. This is backed up by really nice multipliers... under the condition your enemies can burn for 2 minutes. If the fight lasts long enough for you to see the end of the 2 minute DOT then C.Hibiki's damage is amongst the best - but if you're looking for extreme burst damage then you better keep looking.

students.Name: Noa
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Premium Akane, has focus target for Goz
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A tanky (kinda) unit with the ability to provide DEF down. This is nothing ground breaking but filling two roles at once is convenient and allows for extra flexibility when teambuilding. The focus fire is pretty useful in convincing your team to hit the correct enemy amongst many for raids that need it.

students.Name: Utaha (Cheer Squad)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Your usual indoor blue dps
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: C.Utaha does damage. That's it. She does damage. She's pretty good at it too, being quite the competitive AA DPS in any Blue content. Her main benefit is that her EX gives a buff to her AAs for 90 seconds, but the drawback is that the buff itself is not on the same tier as the usual AA hypercarries. All this means C.Utaha plays a more passive role in the fight where you just drop her into your team and let her do some AFK work. She is not suitable as a hypercarry.

students.Name: Akane (Bunny)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Premium ATK statstick for Blue team
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Unlike other global attack buffers, B.Akane's buff only affects Mystic attackers - this restriction comes with the benefit of providing a much more potent buff to the eligible students. For this reason alone, B.Akane is a pretty solid support for any Blue team. Her personal damage is also quite decent, giving her a solid spot in raids where blue AOE damage is valued.

students.Name: Hasumi (Tracksuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Same as og Hasumi but overall better kit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: In terms of raw up-front damage T.Hasumi is competent in this aspect due to her high multipliers and self crit buffs - making her suitable as a hypercarry in blue raids. She also has the benefit of a flexible EX cost allowing you to slot her in as a cheap filler DPS unit as well. This combination of flexbility and potency makes her a valuable asset in teambuilding.

students.Name: Mari (Tracksuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Overheal queen
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: T.Mari has... way too much healing. Like a lot of it. Oh my god that's a lot of healing. Why does she have so much healing? If you are looking for a one-button solution to full heal your team from the brink of death then T.Mari has you covered, but the demand for such an extreme solution is a little bit sparse. On average though, she's still a perfectly fine healer you could use anywhere. Besides, a healer from striker position is always useful as it frees up your specialist slots for more powerful supports. You might find her short range to be a bit limiting though.

students.Name: Yuuka (Tracksuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Repositioning tank with low cost is valuable in raid that need em. Shield is life saving
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: With T.Yuuka on the team the surviability of all your students go up dramatically. Besides simply absorbing damage as a tank, she can both reposition and apply a powerful long-lived shield on your entire team. Her blue AA damage is quite capable as well. These things make T.Yuuka an very powerful all round unit who is deployable in any content.

students.Name: Himari
students.Roles: ATK buff, Hyperbuffer, EVA debuff, Cost support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Hypercarry enabler#2, but also with cost regen
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
If the only thing Himari did was increase cost regen for the whole team then that would be enough reason to bring her to any raid; but somehow she also has the ability to (roughly) double the ATK of a single unit for a brief period. This is absurd. 
With Himari the damage output of any team will fly straight to the moon... and somehow she very conveniently has a similar buff duration to the other hyper-carry enabler in the game, Ako...

students.Name: Shigure
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Standard AOE unit
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shigure's kit is specialised in mob/swarm clearing in which she is extremely effective at this. AOE on her Autos, AOE on her EX, burns for everybody on top of a solid base of stats. She should easily be top of the line for destroying waves of enemies... but this content is fairly scarce.

students.Name: Hanae (Christmas)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Heal harder. Statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: An AOE healer who just stacks more healing on her healing to give you more healing. This sounds like she does a lot of healing, but she really doesnt because somehow her heal values are absolutely atrocious despite all the heal buffs she has. She still deserves some thought for her teamwide Crit Damage, but given how terrible the heal numbers are thats all she can really exist for.

students.Name: Serina (Christmas)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Crit Damage buffer, better in long fight and multi-dps teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: X.Serina is a Crit DMG buffer from the Striker position. Although the buffs have lower multipliers than other existing characters, its extra long duration and teamwide coverage makes X.Serina the best choice for multi-DPS comps rather than hypercarry comps. These widespread buffs are good enough reason on its own to use her. X.Serina can also act as a very formidable subtank, altogether making her a welcome addition to your roster.

students.Name: Fuuka (New Year)
students.Roles: ATK buff, CDmg Buff, Shielder, Cost support, Hyperbuffer
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Really good on any team, basically Pot of Greed
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY.Fuuka blends two highly desirable support abilities: Crit Buffs and Cost Support. She's slightly less potent than dedicated buffers of each type, but being able to do both makes NY.Fuuka a very efficient unit when teambuilding. This slot efficiency is especially important in raids where the other teamslots are occupied by students which are mandatory to complete mechanics. Her real magic is effectively being a ghost member of the team: she provides unconditional support whilst practically reducing the team member count by 1.

students.Name: Haruna (New Year)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Flex DPS/AOE. Does both extremely competently
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY.Haruna's value lies in her flexibility of being able to fill in both single target burst and AOE roles. This flexibility comes from her EX, which can either spread its damage out amongst multiple targets are concentrate the entirety of the damage into one target. Simultaenously filling multiple roles means we can use her pretty much anywhere - but it also means that she may not necessarily be the single best option for either of her roles.

students.Name: Junko (New Year)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Versatile Blue DPS.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Nyunko is a well rounded two cost EX unit with acceptable damage, acceptable range, and acceptable... she's cool. Shiroko equivalent to Blues - you can use her anywhere for anything but chances are you'll have a specialist that can utilise the team slot better. Doesn't make her bad though, just whelming.

students.Name: Mine
students.Roles: Tank, DEF debuff, EVA debuff, (Self) Reposition, (Enemy) Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Very good AOE DEF down on a tank and won't die easily. Has lots of debuffs to help with Greg
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Mine is a tank with the capacity to apply DEF and EVA down in an AOE. This hybrid role means she's able to fit herself into any high DEF raid. But even not considering that, great base stats and a self heal means her simple ability as a tank is top tier. Tank is tank, solid all round.

students.Name: Mika
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Broken.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Why does Mika have extremely high base stats and an absurdly powerful EX skill? Why does Mika have TWO final damage multipliers, completely unique to her? Why does Mika have 100% crit rate? This is all silly, and makes Mika easily the best Yellow DPS in any scenario...
but then, why does she also have HP and EVA stats equivalent to a competent EVA tank? Why does she also get a permanent damage reduction buff? What the hell? Use her for anything Yellow. Don't even ask questions, I've asked them all for you.

students.Name: Kanna
students.Roles: DPS, (Yellow only) ATK buff , DEF debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Nuke dmg is pretty good ngl
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A support unit who duplicates the damage dealt by allies within a certain window. By itself this is fairly powerful ability, but Kanna can also serve as a specialised ATK statstick for Yellow teams. Thus, she fits herself nicely into any Yellow content

students.Name: Megu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: wait faster for new red raid
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Megu is a tanky unit with the ability to clear out mobs. Her ability to heal off her auto attacks helps provide enough sustain for her to be somewhat self efficient. Really good for red mobbing content...but there's not much of that. Otherwise, tank is tank, but you can do better.

students.Name: Sakurako
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Powerful single target carry as AA unit. Better on muilti-dps teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Sakurako is a reliable, consistent AA based damage dealer with no extra complexities or difficulties. Her focus fire ability is some nice utility for where its necessary, but otherwise she provides no team synergies. Due to her hands-off nature, you are more likely to use her in multi-DPS setups rather than as a hypercarry - but she would still be the strongest DPS within that set up.

students.Name: Nagisa
students.Roles: AOE, (Red only) DEF debuff, Healer, (Red only) CDmg buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Surprisingly good damage. You usually use her for DEF down but you'll come to appreciate her dmg and healing
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Nagisa's main utility is her AOE DEF shred. The bit of healing on her basic is nice but it doesn't come up often enough for you to really consider its functions when teambuilding. Her other utility would be the boosted Crit Dmg sub skill which provides a higher multiplier to only Red students. Unfortunately both of the DEF down and Crit Dmg effects only exclusively work on Red students and Red enemies. To compensate her numbers are really high so if you do use her, noone can beat her at it.

students.Name: Toki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: ST dps. AOE isn't big enough to let you use her that way
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Toki's individual damage potential is quite high for a Red unit, boasting solid damage multipliers and base stats to shred a single Red target fairly quickly. All her skills come with DEF ignore, making her a suitable addition to bosses with high DEF. Unfortunately, the requirement to transform before being able to deal any sort of meaningful damage makes Toki extremely inflexible and difficult to use. This is fine in a full length fight where you expect to transform multiple times - but for quick fights where every rotation matters you have much better options.

students.Name: Koyuki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Largest blue AOE coverage available. Solid in all aspects
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Koyuki brings an extremely large AOE ability to the field, which of course is great for mobbing and dealing with multiple targets. Her ricochet ability is a skill to pick off enemies that you don't want to divert your attention to as well. Overall, just yet another AOE blue unit.
Worth noting that the randomness of her EX is more of a silly quirk than it is a meaningful gameplay mechanic. Don't worry about it.

students.Name: Haruka (New Year)
students.Roles: CRes debuff, Crit Res Debuff, Cost support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Mostly used for her cost sub, but the crit chance shred can be nice for multi-dps teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY.Haruka Reduces crit chance res and crit dmg res of an enemy, giving your entire team more opportunity to crit while also making them stronger. This is less effective on enemies with low resistances - you'd much rather just use traditional buffs. But against enemies with high resistances, she can make teams who normally can't crit at all crit. At the very least, a cost-regen sub makes her universally useful for any content even if you can't take advantage of the crit shred.

students.Name: Kayoko (New Year)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Essentially doubles your Blue DPS output and reduces difficulty of a raid by 1
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY.Kayoko provides a weakness buff for Blue damage. This is all she does, but it is potent enough of a buff to want to use her in any blue content you could. With only two cost and a very long buff duration, you can even juggle the buff among multiple members of the team if need be. Overall an incredibly critical pick for blue teams.

students.Name: Kaho
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Her normal take 50 seconds to activate which means she can take too long to warm up. Otherwise generic dps
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kaho is a run-of-the-mill Blue DPS unit. She doesn't have any synergies or utilities and her sole role is to just do damage against a single target, in which she is... actually fairly decent at. Not a bad unit if you have noone else to fulfill the Single Target Blue DPS role.

students.Name: Aris (Maid)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Insane output, can reach dmg cap (4m). Overkill for extreme, like bringing a fighter jet to a knife fight.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: M.Arisu was given an AA Carry DPS kit which could have been a problem because her Railgun has really low natural attack speed... but thankfully her base attack stat is so insane her resulting AA's deal as much damage as other unit's EX skills. On top of that, she has very potent multipliers on her burst EX which synergise extraordinarily well with all the mix of buffs she gives herself, allowing her to roast any blue enemy in a single click if you feel like you want to hurry it up a bit.

students.Name: Toki (Bunny)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Red SIzuna, better Shiroko
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Toki's role as a DPS unit is one that has already been done amongst Red units. She is fairly balanced unit with respectable auto attacks and a satisfactory damage multiplier on a cheap 2 cost EX. What sets her apart from the other 2 cost red DPS units is her additional role as a support. Toki can shred a single enemies crit damage resistance which would provide a significant DPS boost for your entire team. The uptime on this skill is great too, allowing her to fit into any content you like.

students.Name: Yuzu (Maid)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: AOE damage is as big as her forehead. Statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
M.Yuzu does AOE damage. Nice.
It's good damage too, so if you need multiple units within a circle dead then she will most definitely do that for you. 
Besides that, she's a solid ATK statstick especially considering she's an easy event farmable.

students.Name: Reisa
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Does everything you want in a tank
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Reisa is the swiss army knife of tanks. She has a taunt for your CC needs. Her EX actually has solid damage output and range for mobbing. She has a DEF down to support against tanky enemies. Finally, her base stats, constant self healing, and self-cleanse means she is a very competent tank for both long and short engagements. Is she particularly the best at any of these things individually? Not really. But the fact that she does all of them at the same time is incredibly valuable for your roster and building efficient teams. Use anywhere you see fit.

students.Name: Mina
students.Roles: ATK debuff, EVA debuff, ACC debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Debuff machine. Normal actually hurts a lot
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Mina's main purpose is to debuff the enemies ATK, ACC, and EVA. There is very little content that actually benefits from ACC and EVA modifiers, so these two parts of her kit are a little bit superfluous. The ATK down though can come in clutch in keeping your entire team alive against a boss that would otherwise be too difficult for you. Besides these debuffs, her auto damage is actually quite solid, and you'll appreciate having her on the team against bosses that play around debuff mechanics.

students.Name: Rumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: OK healing but group cleanse can be clutch
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Rumi's capability as a striker healer is somewhat nuanced. In terms of single target heal value, she has the lowest among the other striker healers. Even when considering multi-target she is fairly middle of the pack. But the ok-ish healing is an attempt to balance the cleanse she gets in her kit. A group cleanse can come in quite clutch, especially against bosses that can throw numerous debuffs at your students. Regardless, still has solid value as a striker healer to free up Special slots.

students.Name: Minori
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: AOE is strong enough to compete with hypercarry AOE strikers
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Minori' Red effectiveness sub is unfortunately not strictly better than an ATK sub and usually not better than a CDmg sub. The real reason why you would bring Minori is for her absurdly stupid EX skill. Her AOE damage is so dumb that she competes with hyperbuffed strikers in annihilating swarms of high HP enemies.

students.Name: Miyako (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: If you rotate correctly you can have perma uptime on cdmg shred
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Miyako's stats lend her to being just a solid all-round evasion tank. What sets her slightly apart from other tanks is her 2 Cost EX which debuffs a target's Crit Dmg Resistance.  Considering that all teams are capable of critting, this automatically makes her useful anywhere. Otherwise, tank is tank.

students.Name: Miyu (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes:
100% crit AOE. Nice.
Mostly a statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Miyu does exactly one thing. Damage, in an area. That's it. She has a good distribution of stats and her coverage is quite solid. Combined with her 100% crit chance EX skill and other skills which solely exist to make this EX stronger, she's tailor made to wipe your screen. Good catch. All else fails, her crit damage sub at least makes her a viable statstick outside of red content.

students.Name: Saki (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: ATK debuff, DEF debuff, CRes debuff, Special-ATK buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: The only unit who can buff specials. All 3 of her debuffs are solid
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Saki's spread of debuffs affect a range of stats that would warrant her a place in any kind of content. Def down for tanky bosses, ATK down for hurty bosses, and both at the same time for the really mean ones. Her ability to buff Specials is unique, which means you will find a good reason to field her if you are placing your DPS units in your Special slots (though this isn't that common).
