students.Name: Shiroko (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cost support with convenient blue nuke and def down. Good for speedruns
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Shiroko's primary purpose is her cost support. You can't really go wrong with a cost regen sub, and the ability to reduce all EX costs by 1 once at the beginning can help to execute setups that are necessary early in an engagement. This by itself makes her usable in basically any content in Blue Archive. On top of this, she has the neat ability to provide DEF down and also deal some respectable Blue damage, so she can fit herself into these niches where necessary too.

students.Name: Hinata (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solid AOE Red option with very good multipliers and stats. Statstick
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Hinata's passive ability to 80% Def ignore sounds really good and her AOE is no doubt powerful - large multiplier, good base stats, great coverage - but... there is a lack of content that could utilise her entire kit. Bosses that need AOE damage don't need 80% def ignore, and bosses that could use 80% def ignore aren't really AOE bosses. Not impossible we eventually get this content, but for now there'll be better choices in either AOE or def pen.

students.Name: Koharu (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Very strong and cheap Blue AOE
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Although S.Koharu's kit offers nothing except Blue AOE damage, she is undoubtedly very good at this given her large coverage, solid base stats and strong multipliers. The damage she pushes out makes her a desirable pick for any Blue AOE content - which is frankly a godsend when she is a free welfare student. In the right setup, she actually puts out enough damage to work as a carry unit.

students.Name: Ui (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Yellow is already loaded with damage. Let's take it even higher.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Premier Yellow weakness buffer. S.Ui is an auto-include for any yellow content for her ability to amplify Yellow WEAK damage. That's literally all she does. Sounds simple because it is. Damage go up you win.

students.Name: Hanako (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Low cost, high multis, good coverage means she is good pretty much everywhere
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Hanako wears no panties because it reduces the amount of steps she needs to **** her enemies. While her 2 cost AOE EX skill on its own just sounds like average filler mobber, when you also consider her ludicrous stats, piles of self-buffs and insane multipliers, the result is you'll use her in any AOE content regardless of colour. Purple, Red, Blue, Yellow - she's in all of them, and she's the best in all of them. Cherry on top is that her DEF down is unique and it stacks with all other DEF downs in the game. This makes her a very crutch utility unit too.

students.Name: Mimori (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Premium cover for people who are above using pleb free units
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Mimori's main role is AOE Aspd Buffer, but due to the nature of the skill it also stacks with the ST Aspd buffers. She's a solid addition for multi-dps teams especially if they're AA oriented - but otherwise she is just a standard provider of cover.

students.Name: Meru
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Very strong if you can get all 480+ hits in. Quite mediocre otherwise.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Meru on her own doesn't bring much to the team, but if you hook her up on a high fire-rate team she has the ability to rack up hit and damage counts to the moon. In what scenario are you going to be running multi-hit units on a multi-dps team? Not many. Powerful if you can get her to work but not exactly versatile.

students.Name: Momiji
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can yield silly DPS (Damage Per Screenshot) results because of her high ATK
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Momiji has a lot of attack.
Like, a LOT of attack.
Why the hell does she need so much attack?
It's actually just way too much.
Useful against multi-targets in purple and blue raids. Strong enough on her own and doesn't need much to get online.

students.Name: Kotori (Cheer Squad)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes:
Mostly a GA or JFD unit.
Perfect for Red Chesed
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Cheap EX skill with wide range and lower multipliers means C.Kotori won't excel vs multiple high value enemies - instead she is more suitable for clearing swarms and mobs. As far as the main Total Assault content is concerned, there are no red mobbing raids. But if you ever do need yourself the equivalent of a Red Momoi, then C.Kotori will fulfill that role.

students.Name: Haruna (Tracksuit)
students.Roles: Healer, Def debuffer, ATK buff, Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: With no context, her kit is a godsend - but in reality, her numbers are REALLY BAD. At least the repos is cheap.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
T.Haruna's healing values are very mediocre and she is vastly outclassed by dedicated healers. However having a repos at only 3 cost means she can serve as an additional option for bosses that need it. 
Her damage dealt and def down values are so poor that even if you needed multi-target def down in a purple raid she's not exactly the first unit you would turn to.

students.Name: Ichika
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Balanced kit with high stats and multipliers suitable for carry role
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Ichika doesn't offer any utility but she doesn't need any. Her purpose is to mow down the enemy with her extreme and superior firepower. Highly suitable for hypercarry roles and if you can provide her the correct support her output is quite substantial.
Can be a little difficult to use if you don't have the correct support structure, but still a solid unit overall.

students.Name: Kasumi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: High def% shred at a very low cost. Does good damage too
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kasumi's primary goal is to provide an AOE DEF shred - in terms of cost and % value, she's the most efficient unit in the game for this role. Her multipliers are actually quite decent, and if you can get her sub stacked nicely her output is quite formidable in purple content.

students.Name: Shigure (Hot Spring)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Failsafe option to keep your team always at 100% HP
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: If O.Shigure is on your team, your Strikers will simply not die. Her AOE healing output is quite absurd and by her lonesome she can keep your team at 100% HP especially in scenario's where you're being constantly whittled down. Crit DMG sub as usual is a major asset, but really you're just after her valuable ability to make your team invincible.

students.Name: Misaka Mikoto
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Basically Junko without the immortal gimmick and more damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Misaka Mikoto is a pretty run-of-the-mill Yellow DPS with solid numbers, but nothing overwhelmingly powerful. Although she can't fulfill the hypercarry role, she can still hold her own in both ST and AOE roles as an additional DPS on the team.

students.Name: Saten Ruiko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Yellow AOE with some decent statstick ability
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Saten Ruiko is a standard AOE yellow damage dealer from special slot. Nothing novel but more options are always welcome. Since she is capable of buffing the ATK of your team passively, you could totally choose to use her as a capable statstick in any team.

students.Name: Shokuhou Misaki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Surprisingly nice AOE damage on top of her CC
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shokuhou Misaki is unique for her ability to confuse. At the minimum, she's just another (good) long duration CC unit, but maybe there's a future for the confusion debuff in raids. Don't think that is particularly likely though because we already don't make a distinction between Fear, Taunt, and Stun.

students.Name: Yukari
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Incredible one-shot potential but requires long setup
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Yukari's kit takes a lot of time to get online but the payoff is immense. 7cost for a large multiplier guaranteed crit skill means her damage in a single shot is unmatched by any other purple unit. She does absolutely no damage if you can't get the stacks up though, so she's unsuitable as a main carry unit and plays more of a sub-dps role who drops nukes on enemies heads every 2nd minute.

students.Name: Kikyou
students.Roles: Mobber, DEF debuff, Cost Support, Purple Eff. Buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Multi-utility kit with much desired Purple weakness buff
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kikyou is a multi-purpose unit with DEF-down and cost support in her kit. This makes her pretty viable even outside of Purple content because both these utilities are fairly high in demand. What makes her pivotal in Purple content is her Purple weakness buff. Given how weakness buffs are vital to any team structure, she will always have a place when Purple enemies are involved.

students.Name: Renge
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solid sub-dps and rounded character
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Every colour needs a cheap, fast, efficient, and reliable DPS unit - and Renge is exactly that for Purple content. She doesn't have the firepower to carry anything on her lonesome, but if you need another unit on the team to maintain DPS during longer downtimes, then Renge is who you'd want. Due to how reliable she is, she is quite formidable on Blue content as well.

students.Name: Eimi (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Shielder, ATK buff, Aspd buff, Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Shield Repos with decent buffs. The only perm shield repos option.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Eimi is a very good shielder repos option that is finally not limited. Shield values are solid but most importantly the shield duration is lengthy and her pull radius is much easier to use compared to your other (limited) choices. She comes with a pretty healthy set of offensive buffs too - Atk spd buffs aren't useful everywhere but if you're ever running multi-dps or AA based teams then S.Eimi actually turns out to be a bigger benefit than some traditional buffers.

students.Name: Hare (Camp)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Pretty strong single target buffer for non-Himari team
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Providing a strong concentrated ATK buff for only 2 cost makes C.Hare a hypercarry enabler from the striker slot. This makes her a strong pick for any piece of content in the game. She's not strictly better than Himari, but because she sits in the striker slot you can use C.Hare in different teambuilding scenarios to allow additional flexibility within the special slot. Opening up this potential can lead to better results than you might otherwise be used to. At the least she enables you to setup an entire additional hypercarry team after you've already used Himari.

students.Name: Kotama (Camp)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Longest application of single target CC
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: C.Kotama is a great option for lengthy CC. Compared to all existing choices, CKotama has the longest one. She also has a neat little ATK buff unlike any other CC option as well, which can help augment your teams performance just a tiny bit further than you otherwise would have gotten.

students.Name: Ako (Dress)
students.Roles: AA, Crit buff, CDmg buff, DEF debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Crit dmg and def down role compression increases flexibility
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: D.Ako mixes two fairly demanding support abilities into one package - Crit (damage) buffs and defence down. An AOE crit damage buff on its own is desirable on any multi-dps team, but with the combined power of defence down you could easily see your damage potential increase substantially against any high DEF boss. The role compression then allows you to fit other additional supports on your team.You could choose to use D.Ako for these abilities independently, but there usually exist stronger dedicated de/buffers.

students.Name: Ibuki
students.Roles:
ATK buff, ATK debuff
w/Iroha: AOE
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Kotama from the Striker slot
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Ibuki is striker ATK buffer who has solid multipliers and uptimes. She naturally has less multipliers than single target buffers like C.Hare because her buff is AOE - but this makes her much more useful for multi-dps setups. She also has an ATK down debuff to help with survival which contributes to her flexibity in team building. If Iroha's Toramaru is on the field, Ibuki links up with the tank and powers it up with bonus stats and an extra EX. Altogether Ibuki has presence as both a buffer and as additional AOE blue damage when Iroha is around.

students.Name: Makoto
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Largest and strongest yellow AOE, but too overkill for Extreme. Use her anyway to see swarms explode.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: The scenarios you want to bring Makoto to would be when you need to deal with large SWARMS of enemies, not just a mere handful of mobs. She'd easily wipe the MAP with her high damage multipliers and ridiculously huge range. She's not very suitable for mobbing though, because her costs are quite high and her animation is really long, so you'll be wasting a lot of time doing nothing if you're only making her take out like 4 enemies. Additionally, buffing the team's weak damage against Yellow can be universally appreciated in all Yellow raids.

students.Name: Hina (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Damage.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Big Damage.

students.Name: Aru (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: More of a Striker Ako than the real Striker Ako
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: D.Aru is a single target crit damage buffer from the Striker slot. Her multipliers are really good, and is basically just as effective as Ako in Crit Damage buffing a single unit for enabling a single hyper carry unit to deal immense damage. In fact Ako and D.Aru are nearly completely interchangeable and you will choose to use one or the other based on whether you can afford the striker slot or the special slot. Helps a lot with team building flexibility - just be weary her heal sucks.

students.Name: Kayoko (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strongest dps vs high DEF yellow boss. There's only 1 of that though.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: D.Kayoko has enough self crit damage buffs to carry herself to heaven. To unlock this potential though, you'll have to get used to her rhythm while keeping her safe from any kind of damage, no matter how little. If you manage to pull it off properly then she'll definitely do a ton of work. Her also innate DEF Pen makes her very suitable for high def bosses.

students.Name: Akari (New Year)
students.Roles: Aspd buff, Blue-effectiveness buff, DEF buff, Decoy
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Best buffer for multi-dps blue teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
NY.Akari is a TS with some pretty decent AOE damage - but what you're really want from her is the AOE Blue Weakness buff. Granting 60% enhanced blue damage to your team, she's a very solid addition to your roster for any Blue content. Also, because the buff comes from an aura, it stacks on top of other more direct sources too!
The attack speed buff is also nice and it let's her further enhance the abilities of multi-dps blue teams - but that's just a naruto on top of the ramen.

students.Name: Tsubaki (Guide)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strong AOE ATK buffer for multi-dps teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Long duration with relatively high multipliers with fair cost makes G.Tsubaki more suitable for buffing multi-dps teams. The more things you have on your field that can attack the enemy the better she is going to look for you. Not very efficient for solo-dps scenarios but still a very strong choice overall if you don't have anyone else.

students.Name: Umika
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Incredible potential but very difficult to use. More suited for tower. 8 on average but can be 10 if you figure out how to use her.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Umika summons up to 5 turrets that all attack at the same time upon Umika's command. This has enormous potential - any kind of AOE buff can take the scaling of 5 turrets up to the moon. However, getting so many turrets out while keeping them buffed and making Umika actually use the command without anything expiring is incredibly unwieldy. Will take a lot of patience and practice to perfect but if you can then there is noone that matches her output.

students.Name: Airi (Band)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can't really go wrong with perma crit dmg res shred. Also a good AA filler
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Airi is a solid, perfectly rounded AA unit. Just like the other low cost AA fillers, she is not at all flashy but still can be a major contribution to damage without you noticing at all. At the very least, her utility as a perma application of crit dmg res shred is pretty valuable across all content

students.Name: Kazusa (Band)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good AA buff and AA damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Kazusa is an ASpd buffer with very solid AA potential herself. She is a consistent and reliable pick for supporting AA based teams. Although not entirely necessary, using her in conjunction with B.Yoshimi will elevate the team to another level compared to using any other ASpd buffer because of their unique mechanics as band members.

students.Name: Yoshimi (Band)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: More suitable for Tower (Set) than for raid, but still really strong regardless. You'll see her more in GA.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: 10 cost seems like an expensive cost to pay, but its honestly pretty cheap for the complete desecration B.Yoshimi unloads on her enemy. There is no world where a selfbuff that literally triples her own DPS could possibly be bad. On top of that, every 10AAs she automatically unloads an attack that deals damage equivalent to the EX damage of other units? For no cost??????? Absolutely cracked.

students.Name: Kirara
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strong Purple AA
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) A purple AA unit? With red armour??
Not useful in any content right now... so there must be something coming up on the horizon...

students.Name: Midori (Maid)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Balanced kit and strong multipliers makes her good ST purple burst
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Having a pretty powerful one shot EX skill, M.Midori is quite capable at dumping single target purple damage. The kit is fairly simple and everything about her is plug-and-play, point-and-click. Competent enough if you just need purple damage.
Due to her armour type, you're more likely to see her in Grand Assault than Total Assault.

students.Name: Momoi (Maid)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Magdump is as strong as it is funny
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: AA attackers benefit from Aspd, and M.Momoi would not be unusual in sharing this trait. What makes her remarkedly different though is that her AA comes in a tight burst after her EX, in which Aspd buffs effectively act as a damage% multiplier for. This interaction means it's pretty easy to make a secondary team for her as she isn't fighting for the same buffs as the dealers of your primary team... or you could put her on your primary team anyway to see the funny mag dump. She has the damage to justify it.

students.Name: Serika (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Raw damage from the Special slot.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Serika provides a big AOE nuke from the special slot. That's literally it, but it does look like it's a lot of damage. It won't outperform a hyperbuffed striker but it could certainly outperform unbuffed strikers. At the very least as a passive statstick she is certainly the strongest crit dmg one.

students.Name: Fubuki (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strong backline nuke. AOE barely big enough to be counted as AOE
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
S.Fubuki shield ignore is used very specifically for Geburah. 
Other than that, Red Nuke. She's noted as AOE but the AOE is so small that it may as well be single target. Least it's got some nasty numbers.

students.Name: Kanna (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Super Premium DEF Down
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Kanna's contribution to teambuilding is her ability to provide a single target DEF debuff. Thats... really it. But noone else has a multiplier as high as S.Kanna's for as low of a cost, so she's your first choice to the role wherever it is needed. She also has the extra ability to buff Special slot students, so for the few bosses that would appreciate both, she is a highly desireable pick.

students.Name: Kirino (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Dual purpose ATK buffer and Cover can help save slots on the team
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Kirino is an additional cover option who also comes with a neat attack buff for the team. 5 Cost is a bit too expensive to use her strictly for either purpose, but you'll get decent returns if you utilise her effectively for both roles at the same time.

students.Name: Atsuko (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Basically another Serina
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Atsuko is a cheap and effective single target healer that doesn't get any simpler. Her Aspd subskill allows her to provide an additional benefit to teams that would appreciate the Aspd, but you're really just using her for the easy heal.

students.Name: Hoshino (Battle/Attack)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Crazy DEF ignore, AOE output, and high stats/multis makes her easy to use, even vs single target
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Pewpewpewpewpewpew (pewpewpewpewpewpew) pewpewpepwepwepw... BOOM BOOM... pewpewpewpewpewpewpew.... BOOM
I can't think of anything intelligent to write. B.Hoshi just does AOE damage lol, too much of it. Ignores defence too so big DEF bosses die faster. Boom boom.

students.Name: Hoshino (Battle/Tank)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Damage reduction and nullification makes her very versatile tank
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: B.Hoshi is a really formidable tank with two different types of damage mitigation in her kit. Her normal skill regularly provides a hard 24% damage reduction on ALL incoming damage for 25 hits. On some bosses, this is effectively up 100% of the time. For others, you won't have it for long but it will still greatly prolong her life. By itself this is good but she also has complete damage nullification via her portable cover. She basically has an extra pool of health equal to 60% of her max HP every time you use her EX. Really hard to kill.

students.Name: Shiroko＊Terror
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: OG Shiroko and OG Serika fusion
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: A pretty middling unit without her form change, but once you swap forms with her EX, Terroko will relentlessly unleash terror (heheh) on her enemies. Her mix of ATK, Crit, Crit Damage, Blue weakness and insane AA multipliers allows her to consistently rip through large health bars. Ultimately she is "just" an AA unit, so due to the long persisting nature of her damage you wouldn't use her on the usual burst type hypercarry teams. However in a more balanced composition with multi-dps and long buff durations, she'll easily be the largest output.

students.Name: Hiyori (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strongest crit based Yellow ST dealer
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: On average, S.Hiyori is very powerful in her own right and easily pulls her weight as a main carry. Her numbers are good and her kit is super well rounded with two crit damage multipliers, a high damage multiplier, great crit chance, and a latent yellow weakness buff. However, if you somehow have 100% crit rate, her ceiling is absolutely insane and is nearly unmatched by any other yellow Striker in the game. Of course, nothing in S.Hiyori's kit gives her 100% crit, but there are some game modes or boss mechanics that will enable this...

students.Name: Saori (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Yet another Blue AOE for TA/GA. Fulfills a stronger niche in Tower (Chokma)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Saori is quite simply a solid Blue AOE amongst all the existing Blue AOE units. Her EX being targeted instead of free-aim is annoying but it doesn't matter because her damage is good anyway. Having one third of her damage be applied as DOT however can mean weaker compatibility with crit teams, but it doesn't mean she is entirely weak.

students.Name: Marina (Qipao)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: DOT for DOT Boss (Tower)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Q.Marina provies single target yellow damage with... alright? multiplers. Completely whelming character who would do barely ok damage in regular Yellow content. The only way to use her right now is for her DOT which fulfills a mechanic for one boss in Tower.

students.Name: Tomoe (Qipao)
students.Roles: Shielder, Reposition, ATK buff, DEF debuff, (Enemy) Reposition
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Shield Repos + ATK Up + Def down is goated utility
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Shield-repos being a valuable utility makes Q.Tomoe an effective unit in most content by default. The additional effect of repositioning the enemy as well is... strange, but it can have its uses in AOE content for gathering up enemies. The DEF down and ATK up round out her kit and solidifies her as a strong and flexible support.

students.Name: Kisaki
students.Roles: EX-DMG buff, Cost Support, Shielder, Hyperbuffer
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Hypercarry enabler#3, also with cost regen but without any dilution
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kisaki's 80% damage buff is literally 80%. That's nearly doubling your damage. There almost no boss where this isn't useful. Do be mindful though, that she is a buff to EX damage - so you will need to understand if your striker mainly does EX based damage or otherwise.

students.Name: Reijo
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: DOT Support for DOT Boss (Tower) and +2 for Greg
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Reijo is a support that specialises in buffing other DOT units. Practically useless for regular content because taking up a team-slot for this is a waste, but she is a key unit in the tower for Chokma. +2 debuffs for Greg might come in clutch if you are desperate in making another team.

students.Name: Mari (Idol)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cheap EX and ability to convert overheal to extra HP makes her very efficient. Cost Support is amazing.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
I.Mari's primary role is a healer who has is very efficient in both skill cost and practicality. Due to her overheal quirk, the overall survivability of your team is boosted because you are wasting far less heals on units healed past max HP. 
Her ability to decrease the cost of the team is also strongly desirable. It only requires 3 EX uses to trigger, which means she pays off the cost you used in her healing and you can then recycle that cost elsewhere. Overall a clean and effective unit.

students.Name: Mine (Idol)
students.Roles: Tank, Reposition, ATK debuff, Aspd buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Flexible utility unit that can keep your team safe and reduce damage done to them
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: I.Mine being a tank with a repos provides a nice utility to help keep your team out of danger. With the additional benefit of an ATK debuff on the enemy, she can help mitigate mistakes and keep your team living through attack indicators. Tank is Tank.

students.Name: Sakurako (Idol)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Unique ability to Crit buff Special students is... unique. Very powerful on teams whose damage comes from their Specials
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: I.Sakurako will do to Specials what Ako does to Strikers - turn them into extremely potent hypercarries who can singehandledly nuke a boss down. There are a lot less Special dealers than Strikers, so you won't use her as frequently as Ako - but if you did find yourself in such a situation you'll be happy to see the crits coming in.

students.Name: Chiaki
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can't crit but has extremely good numbers
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Although Chiaki's EX cannot crit, her numbers are balanced to account for this. Don't worry, they're balance in a way that she can outperform other purple dealers who can crit. This leads to some fairly interesting setups because you don't need to bring crit buffs to see her perform. Very nice for creating an additional team when you lack the supports to otherwise make one.

students.Name: Satsuki
students.Roles: DPS, Crit Res Debuff, ATK buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Strong ST burst, but hard to buff cause Special
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Satsuki is a strong single target damage that holds up against strker carries. Her kit is very vanilla, her main and only function being just damage - but her numbers are high enough against a single target that you could totally build a team around her to nuke a boss with.
(Unfortunately, her best supports ISakurako and UAsuna are Limited)

students.Name: Noa (Pajamas)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Another Miyu/Meru
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Has a weird way of getting every 3rd EX "free". Just looks like another Miyu/Meru type DPS but her numbers are very strong at least. You're mostly using her for Wakaboat but should be easily usable in any Yellow raid if you can support her with the hitcount.

students.Name: Yuuka (Pajamas)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Weak multi outside of Red - Strong in Red but no Red content and useful tank.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: P.Yuuka's defence debuff outside of red content don't beat other dedicated debuffers, but being a hybrid tank and def down is very useful role compression. For Red content where you need the DEF down, she would easily be first pick in this area. Otherwise, tank is tank.

students.Name: Asuna (Uniform)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: ATK Hyperbuffer for Specials
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: U.Asuna is a hyper buffer - Insane ATK multiplier coupled with healing makes her a very desireable student... for DPS in the Special slot! You're not using Special DPS often, but when you do you'll definitely field U.Asuna.

students.Name: Karin (Uniform)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Scales with enemy missing health. Hit's really hard in cleanup team
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
U.Karin's base numbers are not very impressive but if you manage to activate all her conditions against enemies with low HP, she becomes a complete monster of a unit.
Of course, this does mean you won't be deploying her much outside of these low HP scenarios - but you can always trust the maid to do that cleanup service you may desperately need.

students.Name: Seia
students.Roles: Yellow-effectiveness buff, Cost support, Shielder, Hyperbuffer
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Can't miss with a unit that provides 50% cost reduction. Also comes with other minor utilities that are actually useful sometimes
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Just like Ui, Seia's main purpose is to halve the cost of any other striker's EX, twice. This is a powerful utility you can basically use anytime, anywhere. She has additional tools such as a shield, and a buff which exclusively increases Yellow on Yellow damage - but these are simply secondary complements to her role as a cost support.

students.Name: Neru (Uniform)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Scaling on number of EX uses leads to extremely ridiculous damage numbers
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: U.Neru has a mostly vanilla kit of doing nothing but pure damage. What makes her interesting, and also pushes her to absurd extremes, is how she continues to get stronger every time you use her EX. Each EX is 35% stronger (additive) than the last, capping out at 5 times to make her last EX 175% stronger than her first. No enemy stands a chance against this, even if this bonus resets after 70 seconds and she has to build it up again.

students.Name: Rio
students.Roles: ATK buff, DEF debuff, Cost support, Redraw, Hyperbuffer
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Search and Copy in a single skill... if you've played TCGs you know this is OP.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Rio immediately draws someone elses EX skill - the EX skill Rio draws can exist simultaneously with the original EX skill.
Absolutely wild in terms of enabling all kinds of play on every strategic and tactical level. Basically completely changes the way you play and think about teams, ultimately resulting in extreme buffs to performance.
Assuming you think.

students.Name: Maki (Camp)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Her titanium forehead apparently deletes literal apostles of death and destruction
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Does a LOT of red single target damage. Has the additional utility of ignoring shields, which makes her highly suitable for dealing with the Iceberg in Geburah

students.Name: Juri (Part Time)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Survives Simwsuit Wakamo
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
P.Juri is a tank that eats CC to recover health... very niche, as there is only one boss that has enough damage to straight up kill you in short time while applying CC... but P.Juri is one of very few tanks that can survive that attack...
Regardless, tank is tank, and she's definitely an effective one. In a pinch, she can also CC something for a few seconds which may come in clutch for CC-able bosses.

students.Name: Sena (Casual)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: She's a real healer now
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Nurse: Gives buffs to kill the enemy, has no (real) healing
Sundress: Full healing, enough to revive corpses from the dead
C.Sena definitely has it backwards, but we can't argue against how effective she is. Striker healers are already a rare and valuable asset, and a striker healer who can keep your team at full health through fires of hell? Easily useful, anywhere everywhere.

students.Name: Izumi (New Year)
students.Roles: Healer, ATK buff, Crit buff, Recovery buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: She does the same thing as Miku but literally better numbers
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: NY.Izumi's healing received buff is a very unique buff that could be useful in some niche situations - The % heal multiplier could push the breakpoints of mechanics you may otherwise not reach in heal heavy raids. Her healing itself isn't particularly amazing, but having an ATK buff and Crit buff mixed into it all means you won't be losing too much offensive power for the heal boost.

students.Name: Rei
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Efficient and quick purple mobber
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Rei's AOE and multipliers make her a very good mobber, especially considering if you kill enough mobs with her you can refund 3 cost every 30 seconds. She's not quite good enough at dropping large amounts of burst on high HP targets though - that's the trade off for all the speed and efficiency tools.

students.Name: Sumire (Part Time)
students.Roles: DPS, (Yellow only) CDmg Buff, Weakness Detection

students.Name: Saori (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Hard and fast purple mobber
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: D.Saori is a very competent AOE damage dealer. It's sufficient for both dealing damage against high HP groups, and mobbing. What makes her especially effective for mobbing is after killing 24 mobs, she gets a permanent 101% attack speed buff. This enhances her mobbing further by helping remove straggling mobs your AOE can't reach or tanky enemies your AOE can't kill. The buff increases her single target output a lot too, so she can play a role as sub-dps.

students.Name: Hikari
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Purple Effectiveness Buffer
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Hikari provides a 2 cost purple weakness buff of 100%. As with all the other weakness buffers, the inclusion of Hikari on the team will drastically boost your damage potential to heights otherwise impossible. She has a perk where she decreases the cost of EX skills that change their own cost dynamically, but you're not gonna use this benefit on units that aren't Hikari's sister.

students.Name: Nozomi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Guaranteed crit striker with top output
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Nozomi produces insane single target output. She doesn't do anything else! Just a looooooooot of damage. You should know that the AOE is not particularly note-worthy, but it can be a nice bonus if anything is coincidentally in the way of your main target.
The aiming is tricky by the way - where you click matters because the train will not deal full damage to secondary targets.

students.Name: Nagusa
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: More Purple damage for Purple content we don't have
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Seems to be a fairly competent Purple damage dealer. Pretty vanilla kit and nothing remarkable in use cases. Damage is damage.

students.Name: Niya
students.Roles: AOE, DEF debuff, Crit Res Debuff, Cost support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: AOE def debuff is always useful + cost recovery sub makes her very versatile
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) Could always make use of a DEF debuff. 4 cost is more than you'd like but that's the price of AOE. Her dmg actually seems decent and the cost recovery sub is universally loved.
What the hell is that Crit DMG Res debuff though??? New content?

students.Name: Natsu (Band)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: AOE Striker Healer to sustain your team through gradual damage
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) Healing: C.Sena > B.Natsu > Atsuko
Tanking: Atsuko >>> B.Natsu > C.Sena
General team survival: idk its complicated. The attack debuff is kinda good even if its only 5% when you use her solo

students.Name: Kikyou (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Decoy cat with usable Crit Dmg buff. Blocks other animal bosses from ruining your day
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kikyou summons herself to the field and can take aggro while giving a crit damage aura to the team. Though she doesn't particularly excel in either department, this dual utility will come in handy for some circumstances where survival and buffs can be difficult to individually fit into the team.

students.Name: Renge (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cheap filler Purple ST
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Looks like she has good numbers and multipliers on paper - can't really tell until purple single target content comes out.

students.Name: Yukari (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Powerful AOE unit more useful for FRR and GA than TA.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Big yellow AOE very useful for taking out a group of tanky enemies. Definitely more for Tiphareth than any Total Assault at the moment, but could still find some use on a side team.

students.Name: Hasumi (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Has really crazy crit damage ceiling. Her damage is too strong and slow for mobbing, so not great for existing TAs. FRR unit.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Really good AOE multipliers and has enough crit damage to possibly beat some single target dealers. Regardless, you're going to end up using better single target dealers instead of the ones that S.Hasumi can beat so her role is still going to be AOE. More suitable for Tiphareth than any available Total Assault boss at the moment.

students.Name: Ichika (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Focus Fire, Crit Res Debuff, CRes debuff, Aspd buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Crit Dmg Res Shred + Focus Fire is an odd combo. Looks like new content is coming
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Looks really good at doing one thing, which is removing the crit dmg res of a single enemy. It's an unnecessarily large multiplier though, since content at the moment generally doesn't have enough crit dmg res worth removing. Perhaps new content on the way.

students.Name: Seia (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Auntie that spoils you and loves all your students
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Seia is an EX skill damage buffer, which by itself is a good reason to take her to almost every raid. As a Striker, she allows for flexibility so you're not stuck with Kisaki eating a precious special slot on all your raids.

students.Name: Mika (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: XD stance results in very powerful (and difficult) damage rotations. Extremely high ceiling (if you don't mess it up)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
XD S.Mika does damage XD
XD Oh you want her to do more damage? XD
XD just enter XD mode XD
XD the ramping cost is easily worth the pure unfiltered damage she dumps on her enemies XD
XD if not managed carefully though her rotations can get very confusing XD

students.Name: Nagisa (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: CDmg buff, Crit Res Debuff, Cost support, Hyperbuffer
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cost debt is funny mechanic that lets you push weird edge plays
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Nagisa's Crit Damage buff is competitive with the other crit hyperbuffers. This alone gives her a position on any crit dealing team. As an extra, she has a very interesting mechanic that lets you enter cost debt. Used in its simplest way, it's not too impactful and many players won't see the benefit - but there are some extremely crazy innovative ways to push out the absolute limits of your damage by going into debt, especially around bosses with tight vulnerability windows.

students.Name: Eri
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Clearly built for content that doesn't exist
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Eri does a lot of things. Namely, a lot of damage. We don't know where to use this damage yet though, chances are there might be new content coming.

students.Name: Kanoe
students.Roles: Tank, (Self) Cleanse, Cost Support, Crit Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Hypercompetent self healing tank with really good support
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: As just a tank, Kanoe is really good at that. With her monster HP and DEF values alongside her ability to sustain herself with her own healing and clease, she is very difficult to take down. What brings her over the edge is her CDmg Res debuff to help elevate your damage without overlapping on existing multipliers. The additional 14 extra cost she generates over a 4 minute fight in a full yellow armoured team is also insane. This is enough cost for you to cram a ton of extra damage into the boss, so this elevates Kanoe's contribution by a very significant margin.

students.Name: Misaki (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Conditional AOE damage looks very suitable for Greg - not really going to see 4 debuffs on multiple enemies otherwise
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) S.Misaki has some very impressive numbers - under the condition you can hit enemies with 4 or more debuffs on them. Under normal circumstances this isn't something you'd really do, but if raid mechanics result in you stacking many debuffs organically then S.Misaki would naturally fit in as DPS.

students.Name: Fuyu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Top tier DEF shred, can't go wrong
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Unconditional 47% defence debuff is kind of unfairly strong. Also comes with a very good attack speed buff. Gonna have to see what Nexon is cooking to be combining the Aspd and the DEF debuff, but at the very least her DEF debuff is strong enough on its own that she will find her way into every high DEF raid.

students.Name: Miyo
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good Purple AA for content we don't have (yet)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) AOE Aspd buff is competent enough to be used as is in multi-dps AA based teams. Half her value comes from her own damage contribution though - and there isn't any existing purple AA based content for Total Assault. Maybe there's something on the horizon.

students.Name: Ritsu
students.Roles: Aspd buff, DEF debuff, CDmg buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Brrt Brrt Brrt enabler
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) A 100% attack speed buff on demand for 3 cost is insane. This is powerful enough of a buff for AA based students to completely transform their output and bring them up to EX damage hyper carries. Still, should see where players end up using her since at the end of the day, AA based carries fit in less raids than EX damage ones.

students.Name: Rabu
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Very good CC application. Helmet gang summons are more a meme than practical.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) Helment gang summons are pretty funny and honestly not bad at all. Unfortunately this is usually hindered by a core game mechanic called EX skill order. In a regular team you likely would not be able to get all of helmet gang out at the same time. You can probably dedicate rotation supports to help her get the gang out, but these supports are usually used on more valuable characters...
Thus you're more likely to use her for her bouncing CC, which she is definitely good at.

students.Name: Reisa (Magical)
students.Roles: Decoy, Healer, ATK buff, CDmg buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Magical Girl that shows up and saves the day for any content you want
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) A very very competent healer buffer hybrid with healing numbers on par with proper dedicated healers. Ability to be a decoy for your team helps with survivability beyond just healing, and her buffs are strong without overwriting your usual assortment of buffs from your other students. Pretty much usable anywhere for anything.

students.Name: Suzumi (Magical)
students.Roles: Basic Prof. buff, ATK buff, EVA debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Good AA buffer you'd bring to any AA team
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Our first Basic Proficiency buff that increases the effect of any non-EX damage (AA, Basic, Sub). Relatively low multiplier in an AOE means she is very suitable for multi-AA teams. Likely not going to be powerful for AA hypercarries but we can wait and see.

students.Name: Subaru
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Really good AA carry.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrt. Looks like a pretty strong auto attacker. Strong enough to compete with EX carries without overlapping support choices.

students.Name: Takane
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Revives the dead
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Striker Healer that adds healing on top of your healing because she heard you needed healing on your healing so she gave you healing for your healing on your healing.

students.Name: Yakumo
students.Roles: (Enemy) Reposition, MSpd debuff, CDmg buff, ATK buff, CC
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Kaitenger stunlock machine
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Very suitable for stunning groups of enemies. Her extra buffs means you won't feel like your wasting slots on her utility over damage supports

students.Name: Michiru (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Dokodemoii healer
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Cost support is a strong utility you can't really go wrong with. Healing is also a strong utility you seriously can't go wrong with. Combining them together makes a very versatile unit you could really bring anywhere for anything. Her heal values are actually quite strong too, so even if you're after only the healing she's one of the better options for it.

students.Name: Tsukuyo (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Selfish heal tank
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Very self sufficient tank who doesn't need no help to stay alive. Doesn't really provide much utility for the team besides staying alive, but that's valuable on its own. She does have the ability to provide cover if you need it for the raids that is good in.

students.Name: Himari (Battle)
students.Roles: Healer, (Yellow) Weakness vulnerability debuff, Yellow Eff. Buff, CDmg Buff, Cost Support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: She's carrying the fatman of all utilies
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Why does she have 5 desirable utilities? All at pretty effective numbers? What the heck? Extremely overloaded kit that would easily help grind yellow targets to dust

students.Name: Rio (Battle)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Red DPS with interesting new debuff
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Her primary function is single target DPS and she appears to be decently capable at it. This kit would otherwise be very vanilla, but she brings to the table a new debuff which increases the damage done by your red students to red armour multiplicatively. Might have interesting applications.

students.Name: Toki (Battle)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cleanse + CC. You're not using both at the same time though.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
B.Toki has both CC and Cleanse which opens up a unique role only she can fulfill right now since she is the only character with both utilities! Unfortunately there is no content that actually needs both utilities.
At the very least, she is competent at each component individually. Her multi-cleanse ability instead of single-cleanse might come in clutch in weird cases.

students.Name: Aris (Battle)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Doof Doof. Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:

students.Name: Kei
students.Roles: ATK Buff, Blue Eff. Buff, Sub DPS, Crit Buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Unfairly strong AOE buffer for blue teams
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kei's AOE ATK buff (which stacks with most other ATK Buffs!) is on par with the other key ATK buffers, but on top of this already useful ability is her AOE Blue Effectiveness buff which will amplify your blue output to new extremes. If that wasn't enough, the damage accumulation bomb should easily let Kei hold her own as a sub-dps for the team. Easily used everywhere.

students.Name: Eimi (Battle)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Eats ASpd Buffs and converts to damage multiplier. Equally as strong as Fes DPS with Aspd Buff. Don't bother with no Aspd.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
B.Eimi is a unique character who converts any ASpd buffs applied to her into damage. Not that compatible with traditional Crit/ATK buffs, but this lack of overlap means she extends the number of teams you can field. If enabled with the correct buffs, easily a top tier DPS.
At the very least, a creative and new way to approach team building.

students.Name: Yuzu (Battle)
students.Roles: ATK Buff, Crit Res Debuff, Cost Support
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: 3 cost saves per use has interesting applications. Good partner for redraw DPS
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
B.Yuzu saving cost 3 times per use has unique applications compared to two or one. This can be confusing in standard comps, since it effectively extends entire "rotations" to be 16 EXs long. Althought it's much easier to use on on DPS with redraws on their EX.
Note the ATK buff reapplies on each cast of the recipients EX. This constant reapplication means Yuzu's ATK buff will always overwrite others.

students.Name: Koyuki (Pajama)
students.Roles: ASpd Buff, Crit DMG Buff, Cleanse
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Cleanse and CDMG combo unit makes teambuilding very easy for cleanse raids.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Generally speaking, P.Koyuki's role as a Crit Damage buffer on its own is something you should not seriously consider. The reason why you'd want to field her is the role compression she offers with Cleanse as a utility. Since Cleanse is a core utility on certain raids, this makes her one of the most flexible choices for doing those specific mechanics and increasing the output of your entire team.

students.Name: Konoka
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: OK generic tank, good tank vs hitcount
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Konoka as a generic tank is somewhat passable. She has the stats to be a tank, but she doesn't seriously offer much more than that. The content she is best at is specifically against bosses that would hit you 25+ times to trigger her subskill - this keeps her alive better and lets you continue chaining her EX for more self sustain. Outside of this niche, tank is tank.

students.Name: Rena
students.Roles: Special-CDmg buff, Special-ATK Buff, Cleanse, Healing
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Solo buffing Special DPS stonks
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Rena enables you to run Special DPS teams which open up a layer of teambuilding entirely independent from common setups. This on its own is very nice to have to push extra damage in situations you would otherwise have to forfeit. In raids where Special DPS teams are critical, Rena is an extremely slot efficient hypercarry enabler for those DPS. The additional Cleanse is also a fantastic role compression perk for raids which have Cleanse as a key mechanic, increasing her slot efficiency further.

students.Name: Akane (Uniform)
students.Roles: (Red) Weakness vulnerability debuff, DPS, Crit DMG Buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Unique weakness debuff makes her very usable in Red
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: U.Akane is Special DPS with the gimmick of her damage being applied not as EX damage, but Basic damage. In a vacuum, she's very competent DPS from the Special slot. Her value increases in certain team comps if you are able to make greater use of her unique weakness debuff. Overall great character for Red Raids which can extend your team building capacity if there are more important Striker slots to fill.

students.Name: Kurumi
students.Roles: Tank, (Self) Heal, CC, CD Res Debuff, Cost Support, ATK Buff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Super utility unit that kind of does a little too much. Why does she have 6 different buffs/debuffs in her kit??
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Kurumi is a do-it-all unit who is not only a strong self-sustaining tank, but also comes with a bunch of utilities that can enhance the output of any team. The numbers on these utilities aren't necessarily big or better than dedicated buffers, but the fact she has them and they generally stack on top of dedicated buffers makes all of these small extra additions very very very efficient. Fantastic unit for flexible teambuilding.

students.Name: Niko
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Generic AOE EX Buff is always usable somehow somewhere. Cleanse is cool.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Niko's ability to buff the EX damage of teammates around her is always going to be a servicable utility for all content. She won't strictly be the best at this, especially because her buff is somewhat backloaded, but there's always appetite to run more teams. In raids where Cleanse is valuable, the role compression could make her more critical than dedicated EX buffers. Great unit to have on your roster overall.

students.Name: Otogi
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Funny AA dealer that scales on EX
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: Otogi has a unique property where all her damage scales on EX buffs. While her output is nothing to sneeze at with dedicated hyperbuffers, Otogi fits herself better into multi-DPS teams where you might use AOE buffs instead. This flexibility as both hypercarry and sub-DPS makes teambuilding more fun!

students.Name: Erika
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Uniquely cleanses 3 debuffs
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
Erika's usage in general is limited to being a pretty servicable healer. In terms of pure HP output, she's typically going to be beat by many other dedicated healing characters so you wouldn't think of her as a first choice in many situations.
Where she actually stands out is her additional ability to cleanse. This makes her a very slot efficient pick in cleanse-relevant raids. She truly stands out with her ability to cleanse multiple debuffs. Extremely effective at this niche, but you aren't really thinking of her outside of this.

students.Name: Haruka (Dress)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Her damage is unforgivable, unforgivable, unforgivable.
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
D.Haruka doesn't offer you any utility or solve any interesting problems for you. What she does offer you is the blood of her enemies on a silver platter after you innocently told her to "help me deal with this annoyance". She ignores the defences of her enemy, cutting right to the root of the problem without letting any baggage get in the way. In this sense, she's pretty damn self-sufficient without support.
Tons of damage.

students.Name: Mutsuki (Dress)
students.Roles: DPS, (Special) ATK Buff, Crit Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Claw breaker for Crab...
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: D.Mutsuki's primary purpose is pure damage from the Special Slot. This is typically niche, but if you have the capacity for it after running through your main teams, she would be among your first considerations because of her utility to additionally buff the other Special's ATK. This would make her fairly competent in Special DPS teams, but you wouldn't really attempt to field her otherwise.

students.Name: Nagusa (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Red Eff. Buff, CD Res Debuff
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Red Special Hyperbuffer
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: S.Nagusa elevates your Red Special DPS to a completely different level. She is the final piece for Special DPS to truly become hypercarry status in all Red content. This in itself isn't particularly impressive, but what it does is enable you to run entire extra fully functional powerful teams with no overlap to existing Striker DPS focused setups. Having an extra team in your pocket is what truly lets you to push content you have no business doing. Very nice for teambuilding.

students.Name: Shunling (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Another Cost Battery
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Her sole purpose really does seem to be providing a Cost Battery for the moment. Her damage isn't necessarily bad, but she has 3 limited uses of the EX before you're realistically just going to withdraw on her. Might see use in GA maybe.

students.Name: Shun (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: More Purple damage for Purple content we don't have
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Probably decent Single Target Purple DPS, but doesn't have a place in any current TA.

students.Name: Kisaki (Swimsuit)
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Incredibly potent in fast cycle low cost teams - lets you non stop spam for the best seizures
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis)

students.Name: Satsuki (Swimsuit)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes:
(Pre-analysis) Appears to do way too many things at the same time as a support character. Strong 2 Cost Healing already qualifies her to be useful anywhere she would survive - but the DEF debuff on top of that makes her very flexible in almost all content in the game.
Not to mention that ATK Buff on the Sub Skill. This is, at the moment, a rare buff that doesn't compete for slots in the current roster.

students.Name: Makoto (Swimsuit)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Seems to be strong AOE Blue Dealer, but with the benefit of applying an AOE DEF Debuff from the SUB SKILL slot before attacking.

students.Name: Chiaki (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: Ylw Eff. Buff, CD Res Debuff, Shield-ignore, DPS
students.Stokesia's Notes/Short Notes: Yellow Geb?
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Shield ignore is a bit suspicious. Her numbers aren't bad, but she's not going to be stronger than Strikers unless they give us Yellow Special content..........................

students.Name: Ibuki (Swimsuit)
students.Roles: CDmg Buff, Cost Support, DEF Buff, Heal Buff, Healing
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Ignoring her friend gimmick, a 70% Crit DMG buff with a Cost Recovery Sub makes her a fantastic hyperbuffer in all scenarios. The friend gimmick adds an interesting layer to teambuilding where Sub-DPS could see more benefit than extra hyperbuffers. Having the direct ability to increase the output of the healer can also open up some otherwise impossible plays.

students.Name: Iroha (Swimsuit)
students.Causew's Notes/Long Notes: (Pre-analysis) Very powerful DPS but not to be used Solo. Benefits greatly if her duo DPS also has their own set of buffs or debuffs
